contracts_mapped.name: app_id
contracts_mapped.description: It is the app identifier from the AppsFlyer dashboard, and it travels in the path. iOS apps must be prefixed with `id`.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Put the dashboard app ID in the path after `/inappevent/`. Prefix iOS IDs with `id`.

contracts_mapped.name: appsflyer_id
contracts_mapped.description: It is the AppsFlyer device identifier generated on first launch, and the endpoint requires it.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the `appsflyer_id` the SDK generated for this install.

contracts_mapped.name: eventName
contracts_mapped.description: Event names cannot start with quote, equals, plus or minus and cannot contain spaces. Custom names remain allowed.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set `eventName` to the event the marketer expects, such as `af_purchase`.

contracts_mapped.name: eventValue
contracts_mapped.description: AppsFlyer documents `eventValue` as required. Send an empty string when the event has no value.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send a JSON object string, or `""` when there is no value.

contracts_mapped.name: att
contracts_mapped.description: It is the iOS ATTrackingManager status. AppsFlyer documents 0 not determined, 1 restricted, 2 denied, 3 authorized.

contracts_mapped.name: advertising_id
contracts_mapped.description: It is the Android GAID. AppsFlyer documents a UUID.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the GAID as a UUID.

contracts_mapped.name: idfa
contracts_mapped.description: It is the iOS IDFA. AppsFlyer documents a UUID.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the IDFA as a UUID.

contracts_mapped.name: idfv
contracts_mapped.description: It is the iOS IDFV. AppsFlyer documents a UUID.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the IDFV as a UUID.

contracts_mapped.name: oaid
contracts_mapped.description: It is the Android OAID, used when GAID is not available. AppsFlyer's sample is a UUID.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the OAID as a UUID.

contracts_mapped.name: customer_user_id
contracts_mapped.description: It is the advertiser's user id. AppsFlyer documents `customer_user_id` as a unique user identifier set by the app owner.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `customer_user_id`, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.name: fb_login_id
contracts_mapped.description: It is the Facebook Login ID. AppsFlyer documents a numeric string.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `fb_login_id` as digits only, such as `10293847561029384`.

contracts_mapped.name: bundleIdentifier
contracts_mapped.description: It is the app bundle id. AppsFlyer documents it as best practice for campaign optimization.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the bundle id, such as `com.example.myapp`, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.name: app_version_name
contracts_mapped.description: It is the public app version name. AppsFlyer documents `app_version_name` on both Android and iOS payloads.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `app_version_name`, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.name: consent_data.manual.gdpr_applies
contracts_mapped.description: It is whether GDPR applies. AppsFlyer documents a boolean on the manual consent object.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `true` or `false` in `consent_data.manual.gdpr_applies`.

contracts_mapped.name: consent_data.manual.ad_user_data_enabled
contracts_mapped.description: It is the ad-user-data consent flag. AppsFlyer documents a boolean on the manual consent object.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `true` or `false` in `consent_data.manual.ad_user_data_enabled`.

contracts_mapped.name: consent_data.manual.ad_personalization_enabled
contracts_mapped.description: It is the ad-personalization consent flag. AppsFlyer documents a boolean on the manual consent object.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `true` or `false` in `consent_data.manual.ad_personalization_enabled`.

contracts_mapped.name: aie
contracts_mapped.description: AppsFlyer documents `aie` as a boolean. `true` means the user agreed to share the advertiser ID.

contracts_mapped.name: app_type
contracts_mapped.description: AppsFlyer documents `app_clip` when the event happened in an app clip. Omit the field otherwise.

contracts_mapped.name: os
contracts_mapped.description: It is the device OS version. AppsFlyer documents it as required for correct processing, and assumes iOS 14.5 when it is omitted on iOS.

contracts_mapped.name: eventTime
contracts_mapped.description: AppsFlyer documents UTC as `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss.sss`. An epoch number is stamped as the arrival time instead.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send UTC as `2019-05-15 12:17:01.123`, with a space, not `T`.

contracts_mapped.name: eventCurrency
contracts_mapped.description: It is an ISO 4217 currency code.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Use the three-letter code, such as `USD`.

contracts_mapped.name: email_hashed
contracts_mapped.description: Email must be trimmed, lowercased, and SHA-256 hashed before it is sent.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Trim and lowercase the address, hash it with SHA-256, and send the hex digest.

contracts_mapped.name: phone_number_hashed
contracts_mapped.description: Phone must be normalized and SHA-256 hashed before it is sent.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Strip symbols and leading zeros, keep the country code, hash with SHA-256, and send the hex digest.

contracts_mapped.name: phone_number_e164_hashed
contracts_mapped.description: An E.164 phone number must be SHA-256 hashed before it is sent.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Normalize to E.164, hash with SHA-256, and send the hex digest.

contracts_mapped.name: first_name_hashed
contracts_mapped.description: First name must be lowercased and SHA-256 hashed before it is sent.

contracts_mapped.name: last_name_hashed
contracts_mapped.description: Last name must be lowercased and SHA-256 hashed before it is sent.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Lowercase the name, hash it with SHA-256, and send the hex digest.

cross_field_inventory.message: This app ID is digits only. AppsFlyer documents that iOS IDs must be prefixed with `id`; without it the call still returns 200 and the event is not recorded.

cross_field_inventory.message: A field carries what looks like a raw email address. AppsFlyer documents email as `email_hashed`, SHA-256 hashed on the client side.
cross_field_inventory.fix_hint: Trim the address, lowercase it, hash it with SHA-256, and send it as `email_hashed`.

cross_field_inventory.message: `ip` looks like a SHA-256 digest, but AppsFlyer documents it as the device IP address, unhashed.
cross_field_inventory.fix_hint: Send the raw IP address. Hashing it makes geo matching fail.

missing_requirements.reason: Complete captures bind app_id and the body. Android-looking package routes, Windows apps and installed-device OS cannot be classified from arbitrary dashboard app IDs alone.

missing_requirements.requirement: Original hash inputs, USD-equivalent aggregation and ROI360 duplicate-revenue policy
missing_requirements.reason: Original personal data, historical hourly FX/app currency settings and the ROI360 subscription are absent. Five-place reporting precision and decimal syntax are checked without rejecting accepted raw-report-only values.

missing_requirements.requirement: General2000-character raw-value guidance versus af_order_info3000-character limit
missing_requirements.reason: The exact3k conditional order-data limit is checked. General2k guidance describes raw-data truncation and differs from the newer specific order limit; it is not treated as a universal ingestion failure.

missing_requirements.requirement: Per-array original item identity and ordering
missing_requirements.reason: All populated native arrays must have identical lengths. Actual sku, quantity and price correspondence needs the original basket, not only equal counts.

missing_requirements.requirement: S2S key/app ownership and daily event-name cardinality
missing_requirements.reason: The authentication header and request method/MIME are now checked. Key ownership,300 daily unique event names and subscription features still require account/history state.

missing_requirements.requirement: TLS protocol version
missing_requirements.reason: The current Send Event reference requires TLS1.2 or higher. Complete request captures contain URL, method, headers and entity, but no negotiated TLS metadata. HTTPS scheme alone cannot prove the TLS version.

missing_requirements.requirement: 1KB payload banner versus3000-character af_order_info
missing_requirements.reason: The current reference advertises1KB overall while newer order examples allow3000-character eventValue and prior guidance describes2000-character raw truncation. A blanket ingestion rejection is not inferred from conflicting primary limits.

missing_requirements.requirement: AppsFlyer ID regex and eventValue/IP representations in current reference
missing_requirements.reason: The current UI shows a13-plus19-digit ID regex with a7-digit example, eventValue as json while examples/overview require a string, and IPv4-sized ip while other pages say IP. Existing independently supported models remain; conflicting tightening is not invented.

missing_requirements.requirement: sharing_filter length minimum
missing_requirements.reason: The current reference displays length>=1 without specifying string/list branch or accepted empty-list behavior; older array model and existing empty-list oracles remain. The scalar all alternative and item types are checked.

missing_requirements.requirement: app_set_id member schema
missing_requirements.reason: The current reference declares an object but does not expose normative member names/types in the fetched primary page. Object type is enforced, arbitrary keys are preserved.

tests.session_fixed_clock_policy: Every added case and every source target declares reference_time.
tests.session_oracle_policy: New primary requirements are authored independently in durable source-targets. Original targets are preserved. Six old AppsFlyer fixtures change severity counts only for documented backwards-compatible os; finding codes remain fixed.

assertion.message: AppsFlyer accepts only HTTPS incoming engagement traffic.
The complete attribution URL must not exceed2000 characters.
These PID characters prevent attribution and deep linking.
Campaign names should not begin or end with whitespace because reporting may disagree.
Ad-network links should carry the publisher site ID. Custom owned-media impression examples omit it.
S2S af_ua is sent both as URL parameter and HTTP User-Agent header.
AppsFlyer requires identical user-agent values in the S2S URL and header.

contracts_mapped.name: merchant
contracts_mapped.description: It is the numeric Awin advertiser ID. The published pixel template requires it.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set `merchant` to the Advertiser ID from the Awin UI.

contracts_mapped.name: tt
contracts_mapped.description: It is the tracking type. The image pixel sends `ns`; server-to-server sends `ss`.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Use `tt=ns` on the image pixel and `tt=ss` on the S2S read.

contracts_mapped.name: tv
contracts_mapped.description: It is the tracking version. The published template sends `tv=2`.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set `tv=2`.

contracts_mapped.name: amount
contracts_mapped.description: It is the sale subtotal after discounts, excluding tax and shipping. Awin documents a float with a dot decimal and no thousands separator.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set `amount` to the order subtotal, such as `1083.29`.

contracts_mapped.name: ch
contracts_mapped.description: It names the last-click channel. Awin documents `aw` for Awin traffic.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set `ch=aw` for Awin last-click, or the documented channel for that conversion.

contracts_mapped.name: parts
contracts_mapped.description: It is the commission group code plus amount, such as `DEFAULT:8.33`. Multiple groups are pipe-delimited, such as `CD:11.10|DVD:14.99`. Awin documents `{group}:{amount}` as required.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set `parts` to `{group}:{amount}`, using `DEFAULT` when no group is configured.

contracts_mapped.name: ref
contracts_mapped.description: It is the unique order reference. Awin documents it as required and unique per conversion.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set `ref` to a unique, URL-encoded order identifier.

contracts_mapped.name: cr
contracts_mapped.description: It is the ISO 4217 currency code. The published template includes it.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set `cr` to a three-letter currency code such as `GBP`.

contracts_mapped.name: testmode
contracts_mapped.description: Awin documents `0` for live conversions and `1` to skip processing.

contracts_mapped.name: vc
contracts_mapped.description: It is the voucher code when a discount was used. Awin documents returning the pair even when the value is empty.

contracts_mapped.name: cks
contracts_mapped.description: It is the Awin click identifier (`awc`) on server-to-server reads. Awin documents it as required when `tt=ss`.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Replay the stored `awc` value as `cks` on `/sread.php`.

contracts_mapped.name: customeracquisition
contracts_mapped.description: It names the customer type. Awin documents `NEW` or `RETURNING` on the fall-back pixel.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set `customeracquisition` to `NEW` or `RETURNING`.

contracts_mapped.name: bd[0]
contracts_mapped.description: It is one product-level tracking row on the fall-back pixel or S2S read. Awin documents `bd[n]` as `AW:P|{advertiserId}|{orderReference}|{productId}|{productName}|{productItemPrice}|{productQuantity}|{productSku}|{commissionGroupCode}|{productCategory}`. Price is a float with a dot decimal. Quantity is a positive integer. SKU and category may be blank.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `bd[n]=AW:P|{advertiserId}|{orderReference}|{productId}|{productName}|{price}|{quantity}|{sku}|{group}|{category}`.

contracts_mapped.name: p1
contracts_mapped.description: It is a custom parameter on the fall-back pixel. Awin documents `p1` through `pN` as URL-encoded GET keys.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: URL-encode the custom value, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send a two-letter country code such as `US`.

contracts_mapped.name: user_data.limit_ad_tracking
contracts_mapped.description: It is whether the partner opted out of advertiser tracking. Branch documents a boolean.

contracts_mapped.name: user_data.advertising_ids.oaid

contracts_mapped.name: user_data.dma_eea

contracts_mapped.name: user_data.dma_ad_personalization
contracts_mapped.description: Whether the user granted ads personalization consent. Branch documents it as a boolean, required when `dma_eea` is true.

contracts_mapped.name: user_data.dma_ad_user_data

contracts_mapped.name: event_data.shipping

contracts_mapped.name: event_data.tax

contracts_mapped.name: criteo-partner-id
contracts_mapped.description: It is the Criteo partner ID. Criteo documents it as required on every Delivery API request.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set `criteo-partner-id` to the numeric partner ID from your Criteo technical account manager.

contracts_mapped.name: retailer-visitor-id
contracts_mapped.description: It is a persistent unauthenticated user ID on the same device. Criteo documents it as required on every Delivery API request.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set `retailer-visitor-id` to a first-party ID that lasts at least 30 days.

contracts_mapped.name: page-id
contracts_mapped.description: It is the page ID Criteo issued for the placement. Criteo documents it as required on every Delivery API request.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set `page-id` to the value from your Criteo team, such as `viewHome_API_desktop`.

contracts_mapped.name: event-type
contracts_mapped.description: It is the page or organic event type. Criteo documents it as required on each page-type request, such as `viewHome`, `addToCart`, or `trackTransaction`.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set `event-type` to the documented value for the page, such as `viewHome`.

contracts_mapped.name: customer-id
contracts_mapped.description: It is the authenticated user ID. Criteo documents it as required when the user is logged in, and empty when they are not.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set `customer-id` to the logged-in CRM id, or leave it empty for a guest.

contracts_mapped.name: email
contracts_mapped.description: It is the user's email as a SHA-256 hex digest. Criteo documents trimming, cleaning, and lowercasing before hashing.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send a 64-character lowercase SHA-256 hex digest of the cleaned email.

contracts_mapped.name: page-uid
contracts_mapped.description: It links an organic add-to-cart to the page-load ad request. Criteo documents it as required on `addToCart`.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set `page-uid` to the value returned on the initial Delivery API call for that page.

contracts_mapped.name: item
contracts_mapped.description: It is the SKU, or a pipe-separated SKU list. Criteo documents it as required on `addToCart` and `trackTransaction`.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set `item` to the SKU, or to pipe-separated SKUs such as `123|456|789`.

contracts_mapped.name: price
contracts_mapped.description: It is the unit price, or a pipe-separated list aligned with `item`. Criteo documents it as required on `addToCart` and `trackTransaction`.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send unit prices as numbers, pipe-separated when there is more than one SKU, such as `29.99|15.49`.

contracts_mapped.name: quantity
contracts_mapped.description: It is the quantity, or a pipe-separated list aligned with `item`. Criteo documents it as required on `addToCart` and `trackTransaction`. Cancellations use `0`.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send integer quantities, pipe-separated when there is more than one SKU.

contracts_mapped.name: transaction-id
contracts_mapped.description: It is the unique order ID. Criteo documents it as required on `trackTransaction`.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set `transaction-id` to the order ID, and reuse it for cancellations and modifications.

contracts_mapped.name: currency
contracts_mapped.description: It is the ISO 4217 currency of the order. Criteo documents it as required only when the retailer sells in more than one currency.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send a three-letter code such as `USD` or `EUR`.

contracts_mapped.name: nocall
contracts_mapped.description: It filters sponsored products, commerce display, or both from the Delivery API response.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Use `oa`, `pd`, or `both`.

contracts_mapped.name: verbosity
contracts_mapped.description: It is the product-object verbosity in the Delivery API response. Criteo documents `min` and `full`.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Use `min` or `full`.

contracts_mapped.name: device-id
contracts_mapped.description: It is the GAID or IDFA for in-app traffic. Criteo documents it when Offsite is activated.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the advertising ID for the device.

contracts_mapped.name: device-id-type
contracts_mapped.description: It names the identifier in `device-id`. Criteo documents `gaid` or `idfa`.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set `device-id-type` to `gaid` or `idfa`.

contracts_mapped.name: ctx
contracts_mapped.description: It is the DoubleVerify context or advertiser key. Google documents it on the generated FlashTalking and DoubleVerify wrapper as ctx inside dvparams. The visit.jpg beacon carries the same name.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Copy the generated DoubleVerify tag so visit.jpg carries ctx from dvparams.

contracts_mapped.name: cmp
contracts_mapped.description: It is the DoubleVerify campaign key. Google documents it as cmp inside dvparams. Values may be numeric or a DV-prefixed id such as DV064005.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Keep cmp from the generated DoubleVerify tag on the visit.jpg query.

contracts_mapped.name: plc
contracts_mapped.description: It is the DoubleVerify placement key. Google documents it as plc inside dvparams.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Keep plc from the generated DoubleVerify tag on the visit.jpg query.

contracts_mapped.name: sid
contracts_mapped.description: It is the DoubleVerify site or supply key. Google documents it as sid inside dvparams. Generated tags sometimes send a name rather than digits.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Keep sid from the generated DoubleVerify tag on the visit.jpg query.

contracts_mapped.name: vstevt
contracts_mapped.description: It is the viewability event code on generated video visit.jpg tags. Google documents ctx, cmp, plc, and sid as dvparams, not this name. Generated tpsc-video visit.jpg hops send it, so an empty pair is a truncated wrapper. Quartile event.png hops are vendor/doubleverify-event.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Keep vstevt from the generated video visit.jpg tag, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.name: vstevt
contracts_mapped.description: It is the viewability event code on generated DoubleVerify video event.png hops. Google documents ctx, cmp, plc, and sid as dvparams on the wrapper, not this query. Generated event.png tags always send vstevt, so an empty or missing value is a truncated quartile trail.

contracts_mapped.name: account_sid
contracts_mapped.description: It is the impact.com Account SID in the path as `/Advertisers/{AccountSID}/Conversions`.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Put the Account SID from impact.com in the path.

contracts_mapped.name: CampaignId
contracts_mapped.description: It is the program id. impact.com documents `CampaignId` as always required.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set `CampaignId` to the numeric program id.

contracts_mapped.name: ActionTrackerId
contracts_mapped.description: It is the event type id. impact.com documents it as required unless `EventTypeCode` or `EventTypeId` is sent.

contracts_mapped.name: EventTypeId
contracts_mapped.description: It is the event type id. An alternative to `ActionTrackerId`.

contracts_mapped.name: EventTypeCode
contracts_mapped.description: It is the event type code. An alternative to `ActionTrackerId`.

contracts_mapped.name: EventDate
contracts_mapped.description: ISO8601 datetime or the documented NOW fallback. Full calendar validation is performed by the event_date_calendar rule.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send ISO 8601, such as `2026-08-01T23:55:24-08:00`, or `NOW` only when that is all you have.

contracts_mapped.name: OrderId
contracts_mapped.description: It is the unique order id. impact.com uses it for deduplication.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set `OrderId` to the order reference.

contracts_mapped.name: ClickId
contracts_mapped.description: It is the impact.com click id from `im_ref`. One of the attribution keys impact.com requires.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Replay the stored `im_ref` click id as `ClickId`.

contracts_mapped.name: CustomerId
contracts_mapped.description: It is an advertiser-side customer id. impact.com forbids a plaintext email here. One of the attribution keys.

contracts_mapped.name: CustomProfileId
contracts_mapped.description: It identifies a user on the property. One of the attribution keys impact.com requires.

contracts_mapped.name: OrderPromoCode
contracts_mapped.description: It is the promotional code. One of the attribution keys when the code is assigned to a partner.

contracts_mapped.name: UniqueUrl
contracts_mapped.description: It is a unique partner URL. One of the attribution keys impact.com requires.

contracts_mapped.name: GoogAId
contracts_mapped.description: It is the Google advertising id. One of the attribution keys impact.com requires.

contracts_mapped.name: AppleIfa
contracts_mapped.description: It is the Apple IDFA. One of the attribution keys impact.com requires.

contracts_mapped.name: AppleIfv
contracts_mapped.description: It is the Apple IDFV. One of the attribution keys impact.com requires.

contracts_mapped.name: IpAddress
contracts_mapped.description: It is the customer's public IP, used for fraud checks and mobile install attribution. Send it unhashed.

contracts_mapped.name: CurrencyCode
contracts_mapped.description: It is the ISO 4217 currency of the conversion.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Use the three-letter code, such as `USD`.

contracts_mapped.name: OrderDiscount
contracts_mapped.description: It is the order-level discount. impact.com documents a decimal amount that is applied proportionately across item subtotals.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `OrderDiscount` as a number such as `15.00`, without a currency symbol.

contracts_mapped.name: EventCode
contracts_mapped.description: It names the mobile event, such as INSTALL, SIGN-UP, or SALE. impact.com documents it as required when submitting mobile conversions.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `EventCode` when the conversion is a mobile event.

contracts_mapped.name: AppPackage
contracts_mapped.description: It is the app package name on a mobile conversion.

contracts_mapped.name: IrAppId
contracts_mapped.description: It is the IR App ID on a mobile conversion.

contracts_mapped.name: ItemSku1
contracts_mapped.description: It is a line-item SKU. impact.com documents `ItemSkuN` on the online-sale conversion POST.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `ItemSku1`, `ItemSku2`, and so on for each SKU set.

contracts_mapped.name: ItemName1
contracts_mapped.description: It is a line-item name. impact.com documents `ItemNameN` on the online-sale conversion POST.

contracts_mapped.name: ItemCategory1
contracts_mapped.description: It is a line-item category. impact.com documents `ItemCategoryN` on the online-sale conversion POST.

contracts_mapped.name: ItemQuantity1
contracts_mapped.description: It is a line-item quantity. impact.com documents `ItemQuantityN` as a positive integer.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `ItemQuantityN` as a positive integer, such as `2`.

contracts_mapped.name: ItemSubTotal1
contracts_mapped.description: It is a line-item subtotal. impact.com documents `ItemSubTotalN` as the SKU-set total after unit price times quantity.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `ItemSubTotalN` as a number such as `28.00`, without a currency symbol.

contracts_mapped.name: ItemText1
contracts_mapped.description: It is a general item text field. impact.com documents `ItemText1` through `ItemText10` as optional strings of at most 64 characters.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `ItemTextN` as a string of at most 64 characters, or drop the pair.

contracts_mapped.name: ItemNumeric1
contracts_mapped.description: Published DECIMAL(18,3) reporting value. Extra precision may need rounding; no server rejection behavior is claimed.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `ItemNumericN` as a number such as `10.00`, without a currency symbol.

contracts_mapped.name: ItemDate1
contracts_mapped.description: It is a general item date field. impact.com documents `ItemDate1` through `ItemDate10` with ISO-like dates, with or without a time.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `ItemDateN` as a documented date such as `2026-08-06` or `2026-08-06T13:14:57-07:00`.

contracts_mapped.name: ItemMoney1
contracts_mapped.description: Published DECIMAL(18,3) reporting value. Extra precision may need rounding; no server rejection behavior is claimed.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `ItemMoneyN` as a number such as `12.50`, without a currency symbol.

contracts_mapped.name: kochava_app_id
contracts_mapped.description: It is the Kochava app GUID, and the S2S event article requires it on every post-install payload.

contracts_mapped.name: action
contracts_mapped.description: It names the S2S call. The post-install event article's sample sends `event`.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set `action` to `event` for a post-install event.

contracts_mapped.name: kochava_device_id
contracts_mapped.description: The article requires the `kochava_device_id` key on every post-install payload. The value may be empty when `device_ids` carries an ID instead.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `kochava_device_id` as a stable per-install string, or send it empty and put an ID in `device_ids`.

contracts_mapped.name: origination_ip
contracts_mapped.description: It is the device IP. Kochava documents `origination_ip` as required; the field table puts it at the root and the samples put it inside `data`.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the device IP as `origination_ip` or `data.origination_ip`.

contracts_mapped.name: data.origination_ip
contracts_mapped.description: It is the device IP inside `data`, which is where Kochava's JSON samples put `origination_ip`.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the device IP as `data.origination_ip` or `origination_ip`.

contracts_mapped.name: device_ua
contracts_mapped.description: It is the device user agent. Kochava documents `device_ua` as required so it can parse the OS version.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the client user agent as `device_ua` or `data.device_ua`.

contracts_mapped.name: data.device_ua
contracts_mapped.description: It is the device user agent inside `data`, which is where Kochava's JSON samples put `device_ua`.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the client user agent as `data.device_ua` or `device_ua`.

contracts_mapped.name: device_ver
contracts_mapped.description: It is the device version string. Kochava documents the key as required and allows an empty value when `device_ua` is sent instead.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `device_ver` or `data.device_ver`. An empty string is valid.

contracts_mapped.name: data.device_ver
contracts_mapped.description: It is the device version string inside `data`. Kochava's samples send `device_ver` as an empty string.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `data.device_ver` or `device_ver`. An empty string is valid.

contracts_mapped.name: currency

contracts_mapped.name: data.device_ids.idfa

contracts_mapped.name: data.device_ids.android_id

contracts_mapped.name: device_ids.idfa

contracts_mapped.name: device_ids.android_id

contracts_mapped.name: pid
contracts_mapped.description: It is the numeric Partner ID of the Insight Tag. LinkedIn generates this pixel in Campaign Manager rather than publishing the parameter contract, so this rule is ecosystem evidence, not a published contract.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Copy the image pixel from the conversion's Sources page so `pid` carries the Partner ID.

contracts_mapped.name: conversionId
contracts_mapped.description: Without it the fire is attributed to the Insight Tag rather than to a specific conversion. Page-load noscript tags omit it on purpose.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Add the numeric conversion ID from Campaign Manager.

contracts_mapped.name: fmt
contracts_mapped.description: Image pixels are generated with `fmt=gif`. LinkedIn's conversion API sample uses `fmt=img`.

contracts_mapped.name: eventId
contracts_mapped.description: It is the per-event deduplication key. LinkedIn documents it on the image URL as eventId when the same conversion is also sent through the Conversions API.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set eventId to the same value the Conversions API event sends as event_id.

contracts_mapped.name: oid
contracts_mapped.description: It is the advertiser-defined order ID. LinkedIn documents oid on the image pixel for Path to Conversion, so impressions and clicks within 90 days can be joined to the conversion.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set oid to the order ID you want Path to Conversion to attribute, or drop the pair when you are not using that feature.

contracts_mapped.name: url
contracts_mapped.description: It is the conversion match URL. LinkedIn documents url as a URL-encoded page address used when conversionId is absent. The referrer is used when both are missing.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set url to the URL-encoded page you want to match, or drop the pair when conversionId is present.

contracts_mapped.name: conversion
contracts_mapped.description: It is the conversion rule URN the event is attributed to, in the form `urn:lla:llaPartnerConversion:ID`.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the URN of a conversion rule created with `conversionMethod` set to `CONVERSIONS_API`.

contracts_mapped.name: conversionHappenedAt
contracts_mapped.description: LinkedIn documents it as an epoch timestamp in milliseconds, and rejects events older than 90 days. A 10-digit value is seconds and lands in 1970.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send milliseconds, not seconds: a JavaScript `Date.now()` is already in the right unit.

contracts_mapped.name: user.userIds
contracts_mapped.description: LinkedIn returns a 422 when `user.userIds` is absent. Identifying the person by `lead`, `externalIds`, or `userInfo` instead still requires it, sent as an empty list.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Add `user.userIds`. If you match on something else, send it as an empty list: `"userIds": []`.

contracts_mapped.name: user.userIds[].idType
contracts_mapped.description: It names the kind of identifier carried in `idValue`. LinkedIn documents `SHA256_EMAIL`, `LINKEDIN_FIRST_PARTY_ADS_TRACKING_UUID`, `ACXIOM_ID`, `PLAINTEXT_IP_ADDRESS`, `SHA256_IP_ADDRESS`, and `GOOGLE_AID`.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Use one of the documented identifier types.

contracts_mapped.name: user.userIds[].idValue
contracts_mapped.description: LinkedIn rejects the event when an identifier is present but empty.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Populate `idValue`, or drop the entry entirely rather than sending it blank.

contracts_mapped.name: user.lead
contracts_mapped.description: LinkedIn rejects a `lead` that is not a valid URN.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send it as `urn:li:leadGenFormResponse:ID`.

contracts_mapped.name: user.externalIds[]
contracts_mapped.description: It is an advertiser-provided identifier for the converting user. LinkedIn documents at most one value in the list, and requires a standard identifier alongside the first send.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `user.externalIds` as a one-item list, together with `userIds` or `userInfo` on the first match.

contracts_mapped.name: user.userInfo.firstName
contracts_mapped.description: It is the contact first name in plain text. LinkedIn documents it with `lastName` for probabilistic matching.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `user.userInfo.firstName` with `lastName`, or send the hashed pair instead.

contracts_mapped.name: user.userInfo.lastName
contracts_mapped.description: It is the contact last name in plain text. LinkedIn documents it with `firstName` for probabilistic matching.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `user.userInfo.lastName` with `firstName`, or send the hashed pair instead.

contracts_mapped.name: user.userInfo.hashedFirstName
contracts_mapped.description: It is the SHA-256 hex digest of the first name. LinkedIn documents lowercase, no spaces or punctuation, UTF-8, then SHA-256.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send a 64-character lowercase hex digest in `user.userInfo.hashedFirstName` with `hashedLastName`.

contracts_mapped.name: user.userInfo.hashedLastName
contracts_mapped.description: It is the SHA-256 hex digest of the last name. LinkedIn documents lowercase, no spaces or punctuation, UTF-8, then SHA-256.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send a 64-character lowercase hex digest in `user.userInfo.hashedLastName` with `hashedFirstName`.

contracts_mapped.name: user.userInfo.companyName
contracts_mapped.description: It is the company name in plain text. LinkedIn documents it as an optional userInfo match field.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `user.userInfo.companyName`, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.name: user.userInfo.title
contracts_mapped.description: It is the job title in plain text. LinkedIn documents it as an optional userInfo match field.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `user.userInfo.title`, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.name: user.userInfo.countryCode
contracts_mapped.description: It is an ISO two-letter country or region code. LinkedIn documents `US` as the example.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send a two-letter code such as `US`.

contracts_mapped.name: conversionValue.currencyCode

contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Use the ISO 4217 code, such as `USD`.

contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the amount as a string holding a decimal number, without a currency symbol.

missing_requirements.requirement: Matching historical GVL and CMP registry membership
missing_requirements.reason: Encoded list/CMP identifiers parse exactly. The artifact does not contain its matching dated GVL/CMP registry; current purpose assignment snapshots do not establish historical vendor registration/deletion, flexibility or current CMP authorization.
missing_requirements.next_action: Accept matching dated registry artifacts before checking membership and registration-dependent restrictions.

missing_requirements.requirement: Exact older timestamp-normalization activation date
missing_requirements.reason: Technical history identifies December2021 without an activation day. Known policy4/5 equality and UTC-day precision are checked; published older policy1/2 examples remain accepted. Exact older cutoff cannot be invented.

missing_requirements.requirement: Conflicting TCF2.2 creation cutoffs and disclosure transition-day hour
missing_requirements.reason: Current technical text uses after30Sep2023; updatedNov2023 FAQ uses after20Nov2023. Policy findings stay advisories. Disclosure notice says after28Feb2026 without an hour; March1UTC is the implemented unambiguous boundary.

missing_requirements.requirement: Repeated ct/cv consent discriminator pairing
missing_requirements.reason: The primary table publishes scalar ct/cv. Repeated retrieval it/iv is documented separately. No occurrence alignment or multi-consent request contract is supplied, so repeated consent semantics cannot be inferred.

missing_requirements.requirement: ISO 3166-1 PublisherCC assignment and reserved/default code policy
missing_requirements.reason: Two encoded letters are validated. A complete dated primary ISO country export was not obtained through the OBP reader. The official TCF SDK defaults PublisherCC to AA, so vendor treatment of reserved and user-assigned codes must be distinguished from strict assigned-country membership. No hard membership rejection is invented.
missing_requirements.next_action: Obtain a dated primary country registry and clarify reserved/default country-code treatment.

missing_requirements.requirement: Exact historical or future ISO language assignment applicability
missing_requirements.reason: All 183 current ISO-linked Library of Congress codes are checked as an advisory dated 2026-10-07. A current snapshot cannot establish the validity of retired or newly assigned codes at an arbitrary historical or future date. Such strings remain structurally valid.

missing_requirements.requirement: Placement-origin authorization and actual client IP/country
missing_requirements.reason: Request header presence and approximate Origin representation now validate locally. A capture does not establish approved Placement domains, true end-user IP, country eligibility, or domain authorization.
missing_requirements.next_action: Supply Placement/account and trusted proxy context before applying approval checks.

missing_requirements.requirement: Server-to-server classification for absent, unresolved or conflicting atype values
missing_requirements.reason: Only literal scalar atype=3 or repeated values that all agree on 3 prove server mode locally. Macros, empty values and conflicting modes cannot establish mode. Official retrieval and refresh guides publish scalar atype and no duplicate-selection policy. Supplied malformed XFF still receives a syntax advisory when a visible 3 is present.
missing_requirements.next_action: Supply explicit integration context or obtain a primary duplicate-mode selection contract before asserting missing XFF for ambiguous modes.

contract.name: idsite
contract.description: It is the numeric Matomo site ID the hit is recorded against. The server requires a positive site ID before looking up its account configuration.
contract.fix_hint: Set `idsite` to the website ID from Matomo Administration.

contract.name: rec
contract.description: Matomo documents `rec=1` as required to record the request.
contract.fix_hint: Set `rec` to `1`.

contract.name: action_name
contract.description: Matomo documents `action_name` as recommended. For page tracks it is the page title.
contract.fix_hint: Set `action_name` to the page title or action name.

contract.name: url
contract.description: Matomo documents `url` as recommended. It is the full URL of the current action.
contract.fix_hint: Send the absolute page URL in `url`.

contract.name: _id
contract.description: Matomo documents `_id` as recommended. It is a 16-character hexadecimal visitor ID.
contract.fix_hint: Send a stable 16-character hex visitor ID in `_id`.

contract.name: rand
contract.description: Matomo documents `rand` as recommended so the request is not cached.
contract.fix_hint: Send a unique `rand` on every hit.

contract.name: apiv
contract.description: Matomo documents `apiv=1` as the Tracking API version.
contract.fix_hint: Send `apiv=1`.

contract.name: cid
contract.description: It forces the visitor ID. Matomo documents `cid` as a 16-character hexadecimal string.
contract.fix_hint: Send a 16-character hex visitor ID in `cid`, or use `_id` / `uid` instead.

contract.name: e_v
contract.description: It is the event value. Matomo documents it as a float or integer, not a string label. The official PHP float reader accepts signed decimal and exponent spellings.
contract.fix_hint: Send a number in `e_v`, such as `9.99`.

contract.name: e_c
contract.description: It is the event category. Matomo documents it as required for event tracking and forbids an empty value.
contract.fix_hint: Set `e_c` to the event category, such as `Videos`.

contract.name: e_a
contract.description: It is the event action. Matomo documents it as required for event tracking and forbids an empty value.
contract.fix_hint: Set `e_a` to the event action, such as `Play`.

contract.name: e_n
contract.description: It is the event name. Matomo documents `e_n` as optional and forbids an empty value when it is sent.
contract.fix_hint: Set `e_n` to the event name, or drop the empty pair.

contract.name: idgoal
contract.description: It is the goal ID. Matomo documents `idgoal=0` as required for ecommerce cart and order hits.

contract.name: ec_id
contract.description: It is the unique ecommerce order id. Matomo documents it as required when tracking an ecommerce order.
contract.fix_hint: Set `ec_id` to the order id when `idgoal=0` is an order, not a cart update.

contract.name: revenue
contract.description: It is the grand total or goal conversion value. Matomo documents it as required when tracking an ecommerce order. The official PHP float reader accepts signed decimal and exponent spellings.
contract.fix_hint: Set `revenue` to a number, such as `19.99`, with no currency symbol.

contract.name: urlref
contract.description: It is the HTTP referrer URL. Matomo documents `urlref` as the full referrer used for channel attribution.
contract.fix_hint: Send the absolute referrer URL in `urlref`, or drop the empty pair.

contract.name: uid
contract.description: It is the User ID. Matomo documents `uid` as any non-empty unique string identifying the logged-in user.
contract.fix_hint: Send the logged-in user id in `uid`, or drop the empty pair.

contract.name: res
contract.description: It is the device resolution. Matomo documents `res` as width x height, such as `1280x1024`.
contract.fix_hint: Send `res` as `WIDTHxHEIGHT` digits, such as `1280x1024`.

contract.name: h
contract.description: It is the current hour in local time.
contract.fix_hint: Send the local hour in `h` as an integer.

contract.name: m
contract.description: It is the current minute in local time.
contract.fix_hint: Send the local minute in `m` as an integer.

contract.name: s
contract.description: It is the current second in local time.
contract.fix_hint: Send the local second in `s` as an integer.

contract.name: cookie
contract.description: When set to `1`, the visitor's client is known to support cookies.
contract.fix_hint: Send `cookie=1` when the client supports cookies, or omit the pair.

contract.name: new_visit
contract.description: If set to `1`, Matomo forces a new visit for this action.
contract.fix_hint: Send `new_visit=1` to force a new visit, or omit the pair.

contract.name: ping
contract.description: If set to `1`, the request is a heartbeat that only updates visit duration.
contract.fix_hint: Send `ping=1` for a heartbeat, or omit the pair.

contract.name: pv_id
contract.description: It identifies actions on one page view. Matomo documents `pv_id` as six characters from `[0-9a-Z]`.
contract.fix_hint: Send a six-character alphanumeric `pv_id`, shared by events on the same page view.

contract.name: search
contract.description: It is the site-search keyword. Matomo documents that a hit with `search` is tracked as a site search, not a pageview.
contract.fix_hint: Send the search keyword in `search`, or drop the empty pair.

contract.name: search_count
contract.description: It is how many site-search results were shown. Matomo documents `search_count=0` for keywords with no results.
contract.fix_hint: Send the result count in `search_count` as an integer, including `0`.

contract.name: pdf
contract.description: It is a visitor plugin flag. Matomo documents `fla`, `java`, `dir`, `qt`, `realp`, `pdf`, `wma`, `gears`, and `ag` as `1` when that plugin is present.
contract.fix_hint: Send `1` for a present plugin, or omit the pair.

contract.name: c_n
contract.description: It is the content name. Matomo documents `c_n` on content impressions and interactions.
contract.fix_hint: Send the content name in `c_n`, such as `Ad Foo Bar`.

contract.name: c_p
contract.description: It is the content piece. Matomo documents `c_p` as the path to the image, video, audio, or text.
contract.fix_hint: Send the content piece in `c_p`, or drop the empty pair.

contract.name: c_t
contract.description: It is the content target. Matomo documents `c_t` as the landing-page URL.
contract.fix_hint: Send an absolute landing URL in `c_t`, or drop the empty pair.

contract.name: c_i
contract.description: It is the content interaction, such as `click`. Matomo documents `c_i` together with `c_n`.
contract.fix_hint: Send the interaction name in `c_i`, such as `click`.

contract.name: ec_items
contract.description: It is the JSON array of cart or order rows. Matomo documents each row as sku, name, category, price, quantity.
contract.fix_hint: Send `ec_items` as a JSON array of item rows, such as `["sku","name","cat",11.11,2]`.

contract.name: ec_st
contract.description: It is the ecommerce subtotal, excluding shipping. The official PHP float reader accepts signed decimal and exponent spellings.
contract.fix_hint: Send `ec_st` as a number, with no currency symbol.

contract.name: ec_tx
contract.description: It is the tax amount of the ecommerce order. The official PHP float reader accepts signed decimal and exponent spellings.
contract.fix_hint: Send `ec_tx` as a number, with no currency symbol.

contract.name: ec_sh
contract.description: It is the shipping cost of the ecommerce order. The official PHP float reader accepts signed decimal and exponent spellings.
contract.fix_hint: Send `ec_sh` as a number, with no currency symbol.

contract.name: ec_dt
contract.description: It is the discount offered on the ecommerce order. The official PHP float reader accepts signed decimal and exponent spellings.
contract.fix_hint: Send `ec_dt` as a number, with no currency symbol.

contract.name: _pkc
contract.description: It is the category of the product being viewed.
contract.fix_hint: Send the product category in `_pkc`, or drop the empty pair.

contract.name: _pks
contract.description: It is the SKU of the product being viewed.
contract.fix_hint: Send the product SKU in `_pks`, or drop the empty pair.

contract.name: _pkn
contract.description: It is the name of the product being viewed.
contract.fix_hint: Send the product name in `_pkn`, or drop the empty pair.

contract.name: _pkp
contract.description: It is the price of the product being viewed. The official PHP float reader accepts signed decimal and exponent spellings.
contract.fix_hint: Send `_pkp` as a number, with no currency symbol.

contract.name: pf_net
contract.description: It is a page-performance metric in milliseconds. Matomo documents `pf_net`, `pf_srv`, `pf_tfr`, `pf_dm1`, `pf_dm2`, and `pf_onl`.
contract.fix_hint: Send the timing in milliseconds as an integer, such as `142`.

contract.name: link
contract.description: It is an outlink URL. Matomo documents `link` for tracking outbound clicks.
contract.fix_hint: Send an absolute URL in `link`. Matomo also recommends repeating it in `url`.

contract.name: download
contract.description: It is the URL of a file the user downloaded.
contract.fix_hint: Send an absolute file URL in `download`. Matomo also recommends repeating it in `url`.

contract.name: search_cat
contract.description: It is the site-search category. Matomo documents `search_cat` as optional when `search` is specified.
contract.fix_hint: Send the search category in `search_cat`, or drop the empty pair.

contract.name: ua
contract.description: It is an override for the User-Agent HTTP header. Matomo uses it to detect the operating system and browser.
contract.fix_hint: Send the full user-agent string in `ua`, or drop the empty pair.

contract.name: lang
contract.description: It is an override for the Accept-Language HTTP header. Matomo uses it to detect country when GeoIP is not enabled.
contract.fix_hint: Send the Accept-Language value in `lang`, or drop the empty pair.

contract.name: cs
contract.description: It is the charset of the page being tracked. Matomo defaults to `utf-8`.
contract.fix_hint: Send the page charset in `cs` when it is not `utf-8`, or drop the empty pair.

contract.name: ca
contract.description: It marks a custom action that is not a page view. Matomo documents `ca=1` on events and on Crash Analytics hits.
contract.fix_hint: Send `ca=1` on a non-pageview hit, or omit the pair. Do not send it with `ping=1`.

contract.name: _rcn
contract.description: It is the campaign name used to attribute goal conversions, not visits.
contract.fix_hint: Send the campaign name in `_rcn`, or drop the empty pair.

contract.name: _rck
contract.description: It is the campaign keyword used to attribute goal conversions, not visits.
contract.fix_hint: Send the campaign keyword in `_rck`, or drop the empty pair.

contract.name: _cvar
contract.description: It is a JSON object. Matomo documents `_cvar` as visit-scope custom variables, `cvar` as page-scope custom variables, and `uadata` as Client Hints.
contract.fix_hint: Send a JSON object, such as `{"1":["OS","iphone 5.0"]}`.

contract.name: recMode
contract.description: It selects visit vs bot tracking. Matomo documents `1` as bot only and `2` as auto. Omit it for visit-only tracking.
contract.fix_hint: Send `recMode=1` or `recMode=2`, or omit the pair for visit-only tracking.

contract.name: bots
contract.description: If set to `1`, Matomo tracks a detected bot as a normal visit. Matomo documents `bots=1` only when `recMode` is omitted.
contract.fix_hint: Send `bots=1` without `recMode`, or omit the pair.

contract.name: http_status
contract.description: It is bot-tracking telemetry. Matomo documents `http_status` as the HTTP status code and `bw_bytes` as bytes transferred.
contract.fix_hint: Send `http_status` or `bw_bytes` as an integer.

contract.name: source
contract.description: It is a source label for a bot request, such as `Cloudflare`.
contract.fix_hint: Send a source label in `source`, or drop the empty pair.

contract.name: cra
contract.description: It is the crash error message. Matomo documents `cra` as required on a Crash Analytics hit.
contract.fix_hint: Send the error message in `cra`, and send `ca=1`.

contract.name: cra_st
contract.description: It is optional crash metadata. Matomo documents `cra_st` as the stack trace, `cra_ct` as the category, `cra_tp` as the error type, and `cra_ru` as the source-file URI.
contract.fix_hint: Fill the crash field, or drop the empty pair.

contract.name: cra_rl
contract.description: It is the source location of the crash. Matomo documents `cra_rl` as the line number and `cra_rc` as the column.
contract.fix_hint: Send `cra_rl` or `cra_rc` as an integer.

contract.name: dimension1
contract.description: It is a custom dimension. Matomo documents `dimension1` through `dimension999`.
contract.fix_hint: Fill the custom dimension, or drop the empty pair.

source_conflicts.resolution: Use the known backend URL-query parser semantics for string entries; preserve object alternatives with an explicit information finding until exact native coercion contracts are implemented. No invented size or count limits.

contract.name: idsite
contract.description: It is the numeric Matomo site ID the hit is recorded against. The server requires a positive site ID before looking up its account configuration.
contract.fix_hint: Set `idsite` to the website ID from Matomo Administration.

contract.name: rec
contract.description: Matomo documents `rec=1` as required to record the request.
contract.fix_hint: Set `rec` to `1`.

contract.name: action_name
contract.description: Matomo documents `action_name` as recommended. For page tracks it is the page title.
contract.fix_hint: Set `action_name` to the page title or action name.

contract.name: url
contract.description: Matomo documents `url` as recommended. It is the full URL of the current action.
contract.fix_hint: Send the absolute page URL in `url`.

contract.name: _id
contract.description: Matomo documents `_id` as recommended. It is a 16-character hexadecimal visitor ID.
contract.fix_hint: Send a stable 16-character hex visitor ID in `_id`.

contract.name: rand
contract.description: Matomo documents `rand` as recommended so the request is not cached.
contract.fix_hint: Send a unique `rand` on every hit.

contract.name: apiv
contract.description: Matomo documents `apiv=1` as the Tracking API version.
contract.fix_hint: Send `apiv=1`.

contract.name: cid
contract.description: It forces the visitor ID. Matomo documents `cid` as a 16-character hexadecimal string.
contract.fix_hint: Send a 16-character hex visitor ID in `cid`, or use `_id` / `uid` instead.

contract.name: e_v
contract.description: It is the event value. Matomo documents it as a float or integer, not a string label. The official PHP float reader accepts signed decimal and exponent spellings.
contract.fix_hint: Send a number in `e_v`, such as `9.99`.

contract.name: e_c
contract.description: It is the event category. Matomo documents it as required for event tracking and forbids an empty value.
contract.fix_hint: Set `e_c` to the event category, such as `Videos`.

contract.name: e_a
contract.description: It is the event action. Matomo documents it as required for event tracking and forbids an empty value.
contract.fix_hint: Set `e_a` to the event action, such as `Play`.

contract.name: e_n
contract.description: It is the event name. Matomo documents `e_n` as optional and forbids an empty value when it is sent.
contract.fix_hint: Set `e_n` to the event name, or drop the empty pair.

contract.name: idgoal
contract.description: It is the goal ID. Matomo documents `idgoal=0` as required for ecommerce cart and order hits.

contract.name: ec_id
contract.description: It is the unique ecommerce order id. Matomo documents it as required when tracking an ecommerce order.
contract.fix_hint: Set `ec_id` to the order id when `idgoal=0` is an order, not a cart update.

contract.name: revenue
contract.description: It is the grand total or goal conversion value. Matomo documents it as required when tracking an ecommerce order. The official PHP float reader accepts signed decimal and exponent spellings.
contract.fix_hint: Set `revenue` to a number, such as `19.99`, with no currency symbol.

contract.name: urlref
contract.description: It is the HTTP referrer URL. Matomo documents `urlref` as the full referrer used for channel attribution.
contract.fix_hint: Send the absolute referrer URL in `urlref`, or drop the empty pair.

contract.name: uid
contract.description: It is the User ID. Matomo documents `uid` as any non-empty unique string identifying the logged-in user.
contract.fix_hint: Send the logged-in user id in `uid`, or drop the empty pair.

contract.name: res
contract.description: It is the device resolution. Matomo documents `res` as width x height, such as `1280x1024`.
contract.fix_hint: Send `res` as `WIDTHxHEIGHT` digits, such as `1280x1024`.

contract.name: h
contract.description: It is the current hour in local time.
contract.fix_hint: Send the local hour in `h` as an integer.

contract.name: m
contract.description: It is the current minute in local time.
contract.fix_hint: Send the local minute in `m` as an integer.

contract.name: s
contract.description: It is the current second in local time.
contract.fix_hint: Send the local second in `s` as an integer.

contract.name: cookie
contract.description: When set to `1`, the visitor's client is known to support cookies.
contract.fix_hint: Send `cookie=1` when the client supports cookies, or omit the pair.

contract.name: new_visit
contract.description: If set to `1`, Matomo forces a new visit for this action.
contract.fix_hint: Send `new_visit=1` to force a new visit, or omit the pair.

contract.name: ping
contract.description: If set to `1`, the request is a heartbeat that only updates visit duration.
contract.fix_hint: Send `ping=1` for a heartbeat, or omit the pair.

contract.name: pv_id
contract.description: It identifies actions on one page view. Matomo documents `pv_id` as six characters from `[0-9a-Z]`.
contract.fix_hint: Send a six-character alphanumeric `pv_id`, shared by events on the same page view.

contract.name: search
contract.description: It is the site-search keyword. Matomo documents that a hit with `search` is tracked as a site search, not a pageview.
contract.fix_hint: Send the search keyword in `search`, or drop the empty pair.

contract.name: search_count
contract.description: It is how many site-search results were shown. Matomo documents `search_count=0` for keywords with no results.
contract.fix_hint: Send the result count in `search_count` as an integer, including `0`.

contract.name: pdf
contract.description: It is a visitor plugin flag. Matomo documents `fla`, `java`, `dir`, `qt`, `realp`, `pdf`, `wma`, `gears`, and `ag` as `1` when that plugin is present.
contract.fix_hint: Send `1` for a present plugin, or omit the pair.

contract.name: c_n
contract.description: It is the content name. Matomo documents `c_n` on content impressions and interactions.
contract.fix_hint: Send the content name in `c_n`, such as `Ad Foo Bar`.

contract.name: c_p
contract.description: It is the content piece. Matomo documents `c_p` as the path to the image, video, audio, or text.
contract.fix_hint: Send the content piece in `c_p`, or drop the empty pair.

contract.name: c_t
contract.description: It is the content target. Matomo documents `c_t` as the landing-page URL.
contract.fix_hint: Send an absolute landing URL in `c_t`, or drop the empty pair.

contract.name: c_i
contract.description: It is the content interaction, such as `click`. Matomo documents `c_i` together with `c_n`.
contract.fix_hint: Send the interaction name in `c_i`, such as `click`.

contract.name: ec_items
contract.description: It is the JSON array of cart or order rows. Matomo documents each row as sku, name, category, price, quantity.
contract.fix_hint: Send `ec_items` as a JSON array of item rows, such as `["sku","name","cat",11.11,2]`.

contract.name: ec_st
contract.description: It is the ecommerce subtotal, excluding shipping. The official PHP float reader accepts signed decimal and exponent spellings.
contract.fix_hint: Send `ec_st` as a number, with no currency symbol.

contract.name: ec_tx
contract.description: It is the tax amount of the ecommerce order. The official PHP float reader accepts signed decimal and exponent spellings.
contract.fix_hint: Send `ec_tx` as a number, with no currency symbol.

contract.name: ec_sh
contract.description: It is the shipping cost of the ecommerce order. The official PHP float reader accepts signed decimal and exponent spellings.
contract.fix_hint: Send `ec_sh` as a number, with no currency symbol.

contract.name: ec_dt
contract.description: It is the discount offered on the ecommerce order. The official PHP float reader accepts signed decimal and exponent spellings.
contract.fix_hint: Send `ec_dt` as a number, with no currency symbol.

contract.name: _pkc
contract.description: It is the category of the product being viewed.
contract.fix_hint: Send the product category in `_pkc`, or drop the empty pair.

contract.name: _pks
contract.description: It is the SKU of the product being viewed.
contract.fix_hint: Send the product SKU in `_pks`, or drop the empty pair.

contract.name: _pkn
contract.description: It is the name of the product being viewed.
contract.fix_hint: Send the product name in `_pkn`, or drop the empty pair.

contract.name: _pkp
contract.description: It is the price of the product being viewed. The official PHP float reader accepts signed decimal and exponent spellings.
contract.fix_hint: Send `_pkp` as a number, with no currency symbol.

contract.name: pf_net
contract.description: It is a page-performance metric in milliseconds. Matomo documents `pf_net`, `pf_srv`, `pf_tfr`, `pf_dm1`, `pf_dm2`, and `pf_onl`.
contract.fix_hint: Send the timing in milliseconds as an integer, such as `142`.

contract.name: link
contract.description: It is an outlink URL. Matomo documents `link` for tracking outbound clicks.
contract.fix_hint: Send an absolute URL in `link`. Matomo also recommends repeating it in `url`.

contract.name: download
contract.description: It is the URL of a file the user downloaded.
contract.fix_hint: Send an absolute file URL in `download`. Matomo also recommends repeating it in `url`.

contract.name: search_cat
contract.description: It is the site-search category. Matomo documents `search_cat` as optional when `search` is specified.
contract.fix_hint: Send the search category in `search_cat`, or drop the empty pair.

contract.name: ua
contract.description: It is an override for the User-Agent HTTP header. Matomo uses it to detect the operating system and browser.
contract.fix_hint: Send the full user-agent string in `ua`, or drop the empty pair.

contract.name: lang
contract.description: It is an override for the Accept-Language HTTP header. Matomo uses it to detect country when GeoIP is not enabled.
contract.fix_hint: Send the Accept-Language value in `lang`, or drop the empty pair.

contract.name: cs
contract.description: It is the charset of the page being tracked. Matomo defaults to `utf-8`.
contract.fix_hint: Send the page charset in `cs` when it is not `utf-8`, or drop the empty pair.

contract.name: ca
contract.description: It marks a custom action that is not a page view. Matomo documents `ca=1` on events and on Crash Analytics hits.
contract.fix_hint: Send `ca=1` on a non-pageview hit, or omit the pair. Do not send it with `ping=1`.

contract.name: _rcn
contract.description: It is the campaign name used to attribute goal conversions, not visits.
contract.fix_hint: Send the campaign name in `_rcn`, or drop the empty pair.

contract.name: _rck
contract.description: It is the campaign keyword used to attribute goal conversions, not visits.
contract.fix_hint: Send the campaign keyword in `_rck`, or drop the empty pair.

contract.name: _cvar
contract.description: It is a JSON object. Matomo documents `_cvar` as visit-scope custom variables, `cvar` as page-scope custom variables, and `uadata` as Client Hints.
contract.fix_hint: Send a JSON object, such as `{"1":["OS","iphone 5.0"]}`.

contract.name: recMode
contract.description: It selects visit vs bot tracking. Matomo documents `1` as bot only and `2` as auto. Omit it for visit-only tracking.
contract.fix_hint: Send `recMode=1` or `recMode=2`, or omit the pair for visit-only tracking.

contract.name: bots
contract.description: If set to `1`, Matomo tracks a detected bot as a normal visit. Matomo documents `bots=1` only when `recMode` is omitted.
contract.fix_hint: Send `bots=1` without `recMode`, or omit the pair.

contract.name: http_status
contract.description: It is bot-tracking telemetry. Matomo documents `http_status` as the HTTP status code and `bw_bytes` as bytes transferred.
contract.fix_hint: Send `http_status` or `bw_bytes` as an integer.

contract.name: source
contract.description: It is a source label for a bot request, such as `Cloudflare`.
contract.fix_hint: Send a source label in `source`, or drop the empty pair.

contract.name: cra
contract.description: It is the crash error message. Matomo documents `cra` as required on a Crash Analytics hit.
contract.fix_hint: Send the error message in `cra`, and send `ca=1`.

contract.name: cra_st
contract.description: It is optional crash metadata. Matomo documents `cra_st` as the stack trace, `cra_ct` as the category, `cra_tp` as the error type, and `cra_ru` as the source-file URI.
contract.fix_hint: Fill the crash field, or drop the empty pair.

contract.name: cra_rl
contract.description: It is the source location of the crash. Matomo documents `cra_rl` as the line number and `cra_rc` as the column.
contract.fix_hint: Send `cra_rl` or `cra_rc` as an integer.

contract.name: dimension1
contract.description: It is a custom dimension. Matomo documents `dimension1` through `dimension999`.
contract.fix_hint: Fill the custom dimension, or drop the empty pair.

Empty ecommerce arrays remain valid for empty carts. Quantity is not forced to integer when the current server casts accepted numeric input.

cross_field_inventory.message: A parameter carries what looks like a raw email address. Meta requires customer information to be normalized and SHA-256 hashed before it is sent.

cross_field_inventory.message: Limited Data Use sends a country without a state. Meta requires both together, otherwise it geolocates the user instead of honoring the values you sent.
cross_field_inventory.fix_hint: Send `dpost` alongside `dpoco`, or drop both and let Meta geolocate.

cross_field_inventory.message: A `Purchase` event is missing its value or currency. Meta documents both as required for Purchase, and without them the conversion reports no revenue.
cross_field_inventory.fix_hint: Pass `value` and `currency` in the event data: fbq('track', 'Purchase', { value: 12.34, currency: 'USD' }).

contracts_mapped.name: event_name
contracts_mapped.description: It is the standard or custom event name, and it has to match the browser event for deduplication to work.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set `event_name` to the standard event, such as `Purchase`, or to your custom event name.

contracts_mapped.name: event_time
contracts_mapped.description: Meta documents it as a Unix timestamp in seconds, and it can be up to 7 days before the event is sent. A 13-digit value is milliseconds and lands far in the future.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send seconds, not milliseconds: divide a JavaScript `Date.now()` by 1000 and floor it.

contracts_mapped.name: action_source
contracts_mapped.description: It tells Meta where the conversion happened, and Meta accepts a fixed set of values.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Use one of the documented values; website conversions are `website`.

contracts_mapped.name: user_data
contracts_mapped.description: Customer information is required on every server event, and it is what Meta matches the conversion to a person with.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Add a `user_data` object with at least one normalized, hashed identifier.

contracts_mapped.name: event_id
contracts_mapped.description: Meta recommends it for deduplication: the browser pixel and the server event have to carry the same `event_id` and `event_name` to be counted once.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Generate one id per conversion and send the same value from the pixel and the Conversions API.

contracts_mapped.name: event_source_url
contracts_mapped.description: It is the page URL where the conversion happened, and Meta requires it for website events.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the full URL of the page, including the scheme.

contracts_mapped.name: opt_out
contracts_mapped.description: When true, the event is used for attribution only and not for ads delivery optimization.

contracts_mapped.name: data_processing_options[]
contracts_mapped.description: Meta accepts `LDU` for Limited Data Use, or an empty array.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `["LDU"]` to enable Limited Data Use, or `[]` to leave it off.

contracts_mapped.name: data_processing_options_country
contracts_mapped.description: It is 1 for the United States, or 0 to let Meta geolocate.

contracts_mapped.name: data_processing_options_state
contracts_mapped.description: It is 1000 for California, or 0 to let Meta geolocate.

contracts_mapped.name: custom_data.value
contracts_mapped.description: Meta requires it for purchase events and for any event that uses value optimization.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the monetary value as a number, without a currency symbol.

contracts_mapped.name: custom_data.currency
contracts_mapped.description: Meta requires a valid ISO 4217 three-digit currency code.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Use the three-letter code, such as `USD`.

contracts_mapped.name: event_name
contracts_mapped.description: It is the standard or custom event name, and it has to match the browser event for deduplication to work.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set `event_name` to the standard event, such as `Purchase`, or to your custom event name.

contracts_mapped.name: event_time
contracts_mapped.description: Meta documents it as a Unix timestamp in seconds, and it can be up to 7 days before the event is sent. A 13-digit value is milliseconds and lands far in the future.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send seconds, not milliseconds: divide a JavaScript `Date.now()` by 1000 and floor it.

contracts_mapped.name: action_source
contracts_mapped.description: It tells Meta where the conversion happened, and Meta accepts a fixed set of values.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Use one of the documented values; website conversions are `website`.

contracts_mapped.name: user_data
contracts_mapped.description: Customer information is required on every server event, and it is what Meta matches the conversion to a person with.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Add a `user_data` object with at least one normalized, hashed identifier.

contracts_mapped.name: event_id
contracts_mapped.description: Meta recommends it for deduplication: the browser pixel and the server event have to carry the same `event_id` and `event_name` to be counted once.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Generate one id per conversion and send the same value from the pixel and the Conversions API.

contracts_mapped.name: event_source_url
contracts_mapped.description: It is the page URL where the conversion happened, and Meta requires it for website events.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the full URL of the page, including the scheme.

contracts_mapped.name: opt_out
contracts_mapped.description: When true, the event is used for attribution only and not for ads delivery optimization.

contracts_mapped.name: data_processing_options[]
contracts_mapped.description: Meta accepts `LDU` for Limited Data Use, or an empty array.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `["LDU"]` to enable Limited Data Use, or `[]` to leave it off.

contracts_mapped.name: data_processing_options_country
contracts_mapped.description: It is 1 for the United States, or 0 to let Meta geolocate.

contracts_mapped.name: data_processing_options_state
contracts_mapped.description: It is 1000 for California, or 0 to let Meta geolocate.

contracts_mapped.name: custom_data.value
contracts_mapped.description: Meta requires it for purchase events and for any event that uses value optimization.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the monetary value as a number, without a currency symbol.

contracts_mapped.name: custom_data.currency
contracts_mapped.description: Meta requires a valid ISO 4217 three-digit currency code.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Use the three-letter code, such as `USD`.

contracts_mapped.name: custom_data.content_ids[]
contracts_mapped.description: It is a product ID associated with the event, such as a SKU on AddToCart.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send catalog IDs in `custom_data.content_ids`, or drop empty entries.

contracts_mapped.name: custom_data.content_type
contracts_mapped.description: It says whether `content_ids` and `contents` are products or product groups. Meta documents `product` or `product_group`.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set `custom_data.content_type` to `product` or `product_group`.

contracts_mapped.name: custom_data.contents[].id
contracts_mapped.description: It is the product ID on a contents row. Meta documents `id`, `quantity`, `item_price`, and `delivery_category` on that object.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set `custom_data.contents[].id` to the catalog item ID, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.name: custom_data.contents[].quantity
contracts_mapped.description: It is how many of that product the event covers.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send a whole number in `custom_data.contents[].quantity`, such as `1`.

contracts_mapped.name: custom_data.contents[].item_price
contracts_mapped.description: It is the price of that product. Put the order total in `custom_data.value`.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `custom_data.contents[].item_price` as a number, such as `129.99`, without a currency symbol.

contracts_mapped.name: custom_data.contents[].delivery_category
contracts_mapped.description: It is the delivery type on a contents row. Meta documents `in_store`, `curbside`, and `home_delivery`.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set the contents `delivery_category` to `in_store`, `curbside`, or `home_delivery`.

contracts_mapped.name: custom_data.delivery_category
contracts_mapped.description: It is the delivery type for a purchase event. Meta documents `in_store`, `curbside`, and `home_delivery`.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set `custom_data.delivery_category` to `in_store`, `curbside`, or `home_delivery`.

contracts_mapped.name: custom_data.num_items
contracts_mapped.description: It is the number of items in checkout. Meta documents it for InitiateCheckout events.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send a whole number in `custom_data.num_items`, such as `2`.

contracts_mapped.name: custom_data.order_id
contracts_mapped.description: It is the order ID for this transaction, as a string.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `custom_data.order_id`, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.name: custom_data.search_string
contracts_mapped.description: It is the query the user searched for. Meta documents it for Search events.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the query in `custom_data.search_string`, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.name: custom_data.predicted_ltv
contracts_mapped.description: It is the predicted lifetime value of a conversion event.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `custom_data.predicted_ltv` as a number, such as `250.00`.

contracts_mapped.name: referrer_url
contracts_mapped.description: It is the referrer URL for the event.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send an absolute URL in `referrer_url`, including the scheme.

contracts_mapped.name: user_data.em
contracts_mapped.description: Email must be trimmed, lowercased, and SHA-256 hashed before it is sent.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Normalize the address, hash it with SHA-256, and send the hex digest.

contracts_mapped.name: user_data.em[]
contracts_mapped.description: Every email in the list must be normalized and SHA-256 hashed.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Normalize each address, hash it with SHA-256, and send the hex digests.

contracts_mapped.name: user_data.ph
contracts_mapped.description: Phone numbers must have symbols and letters removed, carry the country code, and be SHA-256 hashed.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Normalize the number to digits with the country code, hash it with SHA-256, and send the hex digest.

contracts_mapped.name: user_data.ph[]
contracts_mapped.description: Every phone number in the list must be normalized and SHA-256 hashed.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Normalize each number to digits with the country code and hash it with SHA-256.

contracts_mapped.name: user_data.fn
contracts_mapped.description: First name must be lowercased and SHA-256 hashed.

contracts_mapped.name: user_data.ln
contracts_mapped.description: Last name must be lowercased and SHA-256 hashed.

contracts_mapped.name: user_data.ge
contracts_mapped.description: Gender is sent as a lowercase initial and SHA-256 hashed.

contracts_mapped.name: user_data.db
contracts_mapped.description: Date of birth is normalized to YYYYMMDD and SHA-256 hashed.

contracts_mapped.name: user_data.ct
contracts_mapped.description: City is lowercased with punctuation and spaces removed, then SHA-256 hashed.

contracts_mapped.name: user_data.st
contracts_mapped.description: State is the lowercase two-character code, SHA-256 hashed.

contracts_mapped.name: user_data.zp
contracts_mapped.description: Zip is lowercased without spaces or dashes, then SHA-256 hashed.

contracts_mapped.name: user_data.country
contracts_mapped.description: Country is the lowercase ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, SHA-256 hashed.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Hash the two-letter code rather than sending it in the clear.

contracts_mapped.name: user_data.external_id
contracts_mapped.description: Meta recommends hashing the advertiser's own identifier with SHA-256.

contracts_mapped.name: user_data.client_ip_address
contracts_mapped.description: It is sent unhashed, and it must be the real IPv4 or IPv6 address of the browser.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the client address as-is; do not hash it and do not send your server's address.

contracts_mapped.name: user_data.client_user_agent
contracts_mapped.description: It is sent unhashed, and it must be the browser's user agent rather than your HTTP client's.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Forward the browser `User-Agent` header from the original request.

contracts_mapped.name: user_data.fbc
contracts_mapped.description: Meta documents the click id cookie as `fb.${subdomain_index}.${creation_time}.${fbclid}`.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the `_fbc` cookie verbatim, or rebuild it in the documented format.

contracts_mapped.name: user_data.fbp
contracts_mapped.description: Meta documents the browser id cookie as `fb.${subdomain_index}.${creation_time}.${random_number}`.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the `_fbp` cookie verbatim.
