params.name: event_name
params.description: It is the standard or custom event name, and it has to match the browser event for deduplication to work.
params.fix_hint: Set `event_name` to the standard event, such as `Purchase`, or to your custom event name.

params.name: event_time
params.description: Meta documents it as a Unix timestamp in seconds, and it can be up to 7 days before the event is sent. A 13-digit value is milliseconds and lands far in the future.
params.fix_hint: Send seconds, not milliseconds: divide a JavaScript `Date.now()` by 1000 and floor it.

params.name: action_source
params.description: It tells Meta where the conversion happened, and Meta accepts a fixed set of values.
params.fix_hint: Use one of the documented values; website conversions are `website`.

params.name: user_data
params.description: Customer information is required on every server event, and it is what Meta matches the conversion to a person with.
params.fix_hint: Add a `user_data` object with at least one normalized, hashed identifier.

params.name: event_id
params.description: Meta recommends it for deduplication: the browser pixel and the server event have to carry the same `event_id` and `event_name` to be counted once.
params.fix_hint: Generate one id per conversion and send the same value from the pixel and the Conversions API.

params.name: event_source_url
params.description: It is the page URL where the conversion happened, and Meta requires it for website events.
params.fix_hint: Send the full URL of the page, including the scheme.

params.name: opt_out
params.description: When true, the event is used for attribution only and not for ads delivery optimization.

params.name: data_processing_options[]
params.description: Meta accepts `LDU` for Limited Data Use, or an empty array.
params.fix_hint: Send `["LDU"]` to enable Limited Data Use, or `[]` to leave it off.

params.name: data_processing_options_country
params.description: It is 1 for the United States, or 0 to let Meta geolocate.

params.name: data_processing_options_state
params.description: It is 1000 for California, or 0 to let Meta geolocate.

params.name: custom_data.value
params.description: Meta requires it for purchase events and for any event that uses value optimization.
params.fix_hint: Send the monetary value as a number, without a currency symbol.

params.name: custom_data.currency
params.description: Meta requires a valid ISO 4217 three-digit currency code.
params.fix_hint: Use the three-letter code, such as `USD`.

params.name: custom_data.content_ids[]
params.description: It is a product ID associated with the event, such as a SKU on AddToCart.
params.fix_hint: Send catalog IDs in `custom_data.content_ids`, or drop empty entries.

params.name: custom_data.content_type
params.description: It says whether `content_ids` and `contents` are products or product groups. Meta documents `product` or `product_group`.
params.fix_hint: Set `custom_data.content_type` to `product` or `product_group`.

params.name: custom_data.contents[].id
params.description: It is the product ID on a contents row. Meta documents `id`, `quantity`, `item_price`, and `delivery_category` on that object.
params.fix_hint: Set `custom_data.contents[].id` to the catalog item ID, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: custom_data.contents[].quantity
params.description: It is how many of that product the event covers.
params.fix_hint: Send a whole number in `custom_data.contents[].quantity`, such as `1`.

params.name: custom_data.contents[].item_price
params.description: It is the price of that product. Put the order total in `custom_data.value`.
params.fix_hint: Send `custom_data.contents[].item_price` as a number, such as `129.99`, without a currency symbol.

params.name: custom_data.contents[].delivery_category
params.description: It is the delivery type on a contents row. Meta documents `in_store`, `curbside`, and `home_delivery`.
params.fix_hint: Set the contents `delivery_category` to `in_store`, `curbside`, or `home_delivery`.

params.name: custom_data.delivery_category
params.description: It is the delivery type for a purchase event. Meta documents `in_store`, `curbside`, and `home_delivery`.
params.fix_hint: Set `custom_data.delivery_category` to `in_store`, `curbside`, or `home_delivery`.

params.name: custom_data.num_items
params.description: It is the number of items in checkout. Meta documents it for InitiateCheckout events.
params.fix_hint: Send a whole number in `custom_data.num_items`, such as `2`.

params.name: custom_data.order_id
params.description: It is the order ID for this transaction, as a string.
params.fix_hint: Send `custom_data.order_id`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: custom_data.search_string
params.description: It is the query the user searched for. Meta documents it for Search events.
params.fix_hint: Send the query in `custom_data.search_string`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: custom_data.predicted_ltv
params.description: It is the predicted lifetime value of a conversion event.
params.fix_hint: Send `custom_data.predicted_ltv` as a number, such as `250.00`.

params.name: referrer_url
params.description: It is the referrer URL for the event.
params.fix_hint: Send an absolute URL in `referrer_url`, including the scheme.

params.name: user_data.em
params.description: Email must be trimmed, lowercased, and SHA-256 hashed before it is sent.
params.fix_hint: Normalize the address, hash it with SHA-256, and send the hex digest.

params.name: user_data.em[]
params.description: Every email in the list must be normalized and SHA-256 hashed.
params.fix_hint: Normalize each address, hash it with SHA-256, and send the hex digests.

params.name: user_data.ph
params.description: Phone numbers must have symbols and letters removed, carry the country code, and be SHA-256 hashed.
params.fix_hint: Normalize the number to digits with the country code, hash it with SHA-256, and send the hex digest.

params.name: user_data.ph[]
params.description: Every phone number in the list must be normalized and SHA-256 hashed.
params.fix_hint: Normalize each number to digits with the country code and hash it with SHA-256.

params.name: user_data.fn
params.description: First name must be lowercased and SHA-256 hashed.

params.name: user_data.ln
params.description: Last name must be lowercased and SHA-256 hashed.

params.name: user_data.ge
params.description: Gender is sent as a lowercase initial and SHA-256 hashed.

params.name: user_data.db
params.description: Date of birth is normalized to YYYYMMDD and SHA-256 hashed.

params.name: user_data.ct

params.name: user_data.st

params.name: user_data.zp
params.description: Zip is lowercased without spaces or dashes, then SHA-256 hashed.

params.name: user_data.country
params.description: Country is the lowercase ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, SHA-256 hashed.
params.fix_hint: Hash the two-letter code rather than sending it in the clear.

params.name: user_data.external_id
params.description: Meta recommends hashing the advertiser's own identifier with SHA-256.

params.name: user_data.client_ip_address
params.description: It is sent unhashed, and it must be the real IPv4 or IPv6 address of the browser.
params.fix_hint: Send the client address as-is; do not hash it and do not send your server's address.

params.name: user_data.client_user_agent
params.description: It is sent unhashed, and it must be the browser's user agent rather than your HTTP client's.
params.fix_hint: Forward the browser `User-Agent` header from the original request.

params.name: user_data.fbp
params.description: Meta documents the browser id cookie as `fb.${subdomain_index}.${creation_time}.${random_number}`.
params.fix_hint: Send the `_fbp` cookie verbatim.

rules.message: This field looks like a SHA-256 digest, but Meta documents it as one of the parameters that is sent unhashed.

rules.fix_hint: Add `custom_data.value` as a number and `custom_data.currency` as an ISO 4217 code.

rules.message: The event is marked `action_source: website` but carries no `event_source_url`, which Meta requires for website events.
rules.fix_hint: Send the page URL the conversion happened on.

rules.message: Limited Data Use is enabled but `data_processing_options_country` is missing.
rules.fix_hint: Send `data_processing_options_country` as 1 for the United States, or 0 to let Meta geolocate.

rules.message: A field carries what looks like a raw email address. Meta requires customer information to be normalized and SHA-256 hashed before it is sent.
rules.fix_hint: Trim the address, lowercase it, hash it with SHA-256, and send the hex digest.

rules.message: This field looks like a SHA-256 digest, but Meta documents it as one of the parameters that is sent unhashed.
rules.fix_hint: Send the raw value. Hashing it makes the event unmatchable.

contracts_mapped.name: tag_id
contracts_mapped.description: It is the numeric UET tag ID, and it travels in the path as /v1/{tagId}/events.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Put the UET tag ID from Microsoft Advertising in the path as /v1/{tagId}/events.

contracts_mapped.name: data
contracts_mapped.description: Microsoft documents `data` as the list of events. An empty list sends nothing.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send at least one event in `data`.

contracts_mapped.name: continueOnValidationError
contracts_mapped.description: It is whether a batch should skip invalid events. Microsoft documents `true` to skip them and `false` (the default) to reject the whole request.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `true` or `false` in `continueOnValidationError`.

contracts_mapped.description: Each event is a JSON object, rather than a scalar or list.

contracts_mapped.name: data[]
contracts_mapped.description: The vendor documents the JSON shape or value type of this field.

contracts_mapped.name: dataProvider
contracts_mapped.description: Third-party senders identify themselves with this request-level string.

contracts_mapped.name: eventType
contracts_mapped.description: It is the event type. Microsoft documents `pageLoad` or `custom`.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set `eventType` to `pageLoad` or `custom`.

contracts_mapped.name: eventTime
contracts_mapped.description: It is Unix epoch time in seconds UTC. Microsoft documents seconds, so a 13-digit value is milliseconds and the wrong unit.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send seconds, a 10-digit Unix timestamp, not milliseconds.

contracts_mapped.name: eventId
contracts_mapped.description: It identifies the event so UET JavaScript and CAPI can deduplicate. Microsoft documents it as required for deduplication.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set `eventId` to the same value the UET tag sent.

contracts_mapped.name: eventName
contracts_mapped.description: It is the custom conversion action. Microsoft documents it for custom conversion goals.

contracts_mapped.name: eventSourceUrl
contracts_mapped.description: It is the page URL. Microsoft documents it as required on `pageLoad` events.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set `eventSourceUrl` to the absolute page URL.

contracts_mapped.name: referrerUrl
contracts_mapped.description: It is the page referrer, used for referral remarketing lists. Microsoft documents a URL.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send an absolute URL in `referrerUrl`, or omit the field.

contracts_mapped.name: pageLoadId
contracts_mapped.description: It links custom events to a page load. Microsoft documents a v4 UUID.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send a UUID such as `bcf3000b-65fa-4cd2-808a-8a6cf2b1d0a5`.

contracts_mapped.name: adStorageConsent
contracts_mapped.description: It is the advertising-storage consent signal. Microsoft documents `G` for granted and `D` for denied.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set `adStorageConsent` to `G` or `D`.

contracts_mapped.name: userData
contracts_mapped.description: Microsoft documents `userData` as required, with at least one supported identifier.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Add a `userData` object with at least one of `anonymousId`, `externalId`, `em`, `ph`, `msclkid`, `idfa`, or `gaid`.

contracts_mapped.name: userData.anonymousId
contracts_mapped.description: It is the guest visitor ID, also used for ID Sync.

contracts_mapped.name: userData.externalId
contracts_mapped.description: It is an anonymized signed-in user ID.

contracts_mapped.name: userData.em
contracts_mapped.description: It is the SHA-256 hex digest of the email. Microsoft documents lowercase hex after trim and lowercase.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Trim, lowercase, SHA-256, and send 64 lowercase hex characters.

contracts_mapped.name: userData.ph
contracts_mapped.description: It is the SHA-256 hex digest of the phone number.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Normalize the phone, SHA-256, and send 64 lowercase hex characters.

contracts_mapped.name: userData.msclkid
contracts_mapped.description: It is the Microsoft Click ID. Microsoft documents it as a UUID.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the `msclkid` captured from the landing URL as a UUID.

contracts_mapped.name: userData.idfa
contracts_mapped.description: It is the iOS Identifier for Advertisers.

contracts_mapped.name: userData.gaid
contracts_mapped.description: It is the Android advertising ID.

contracts_mapped.name: userData.clientIpAddress
contracts_mapped.description: It is the visitor IP, IPv4 or IPv6, sent unhashed. Microsoft documents it as preferred.

contracts_mapped.name: userData.clientUserAgent
contracts_mapped.description: It is the visitor user agent, sent unhashed. Microsoft documents it as preferred.

contracts_mapped.name: customData.currency
contracts_mapped.description: It is the ISO 4217 currency of `customData.value`.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Use a three-letter code such as `USD`.

contracts_mapped.name: customData.value
contracts_mapped.description: It is the revenue value for variable-revenue goals. Microsoft documents a decimal number together with `currency`.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send a number such as `123.45`, with no currency symbol.

contracts_mapped.name: customData.eventValue
contracts_mapped.description: It is the event value for custom conversion goals. Microsoft documents a float.

contracts_mapped.name: customData.transactionId
contracts_mapped.description: It is a unique id for singular events such as a purchase. Microsoft documents it as optional but recommended.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `customData.transactionId`, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.name: customData.pageType
contracts_mapped.description: It is the ecommerce page type for dynamic remarketing. Microsoft documents a closed set.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set `customData.pageType` to `cart`, `category`, `home`, `other`, `product`, `purchase`, or `searchresults`.

contracts_mapped.name: customData.ecommTotalValue
contracts_mapped.description: It is the total value of the cart or purchase. Microsoft documents a decimal.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send a number such as `123.45`, with no currency symbol.

contracts_mapped.name: customData.items[].id
contracts_mapped.description: It is the item id on an `items` row. Microsoft documents `id` as preferred on each product object.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set `customData.items[].id` to the catalog item ID, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.name: customData.items[].quantity
contracts_mapped.description: It is the item quantity on an `items` row. Microsoft documents an integer.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `customData.items[].quantity` as an integer, such as `2`.

contracts_mapped.name: customData.items[].price
contracts_mapped.description: It is the item price after discounts. Microsoft documents a decimal.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `customData.items[].price` as a number, such as `25.1`.

contracts_mapped.name: customData.hotelData.checkinDate
contracts_mapped.description: It is the hotel check-in date. Microsoft documents `YYYY-MM-DD`.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `customData.hotelData.checkinDate` as `YYYY-MM-DD`, such as `2018-10-27`.

contracts_mapped.name: customData.hotelData.checkoutDate
contracts_mapped.description: It is the hotel check-out date. Microsoft documents `YYYY-MM-DD`.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `customData.hotelData.checkoutDate` as `YYYY-MM-DD`, such as `2018-10-31`.

contracts_mapped.name: customData.hotelData.totalPrice
contracts_mapped.description: It is the total booking price including taxes and fees. Microsoft documents a decimal.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send a number such as `188.23`, with no currency symbol.

contracts_mapped.name: customData.hotelData.basePrice
contracts_mapped.description: It is the booking price excluding taxes and fees. Microsoft documents a decimal.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send a number such as `165.76`, with no currency symbol.

contracts_mapped.name: customData.hotelData.lengthOfStay
contracts_mapped.description: It is the number of nights. Microsoft documents an integer, and it is not required when `checkoutDate` is sent.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `customData.hotelData.lengthOfStay` as an integer, such as `4`.

contracts_mapped.name: ti
contracts_mapped.description: It is the numeric UET tag ID. Microsoft documents ti as required on every event.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Copy the UET tag ID from Microsoft Advertising into the tag snippet.

contracts_mapped.name: ver
contracts_mapped.description: It is the UET tag version. Microsoft documents ver as required, and 2.3 for a custom implementation.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send ver as 2.3 on a custom implementation, or the version the generated snippet reports.

contracts_mapped.name: evt
contracts_mapped.description: It names the event. Microsoft documents evt as required, and only pageLoad or custom.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send evt=pageLoad on a page view, or evt=custom on a custom event.

contracts_mapped.name: mid
contracts_mapped.description: It identifies events from a single page. Microsoft documents mid as a unique identifier that must change when the page changes.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send a fresh mid per page, such as a GUID.

contracts_mapped.name: rn
contracts_mapped.description: It is a cache buster. Microsoft documents rn as a required random 6-digit number.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send a random 6-digit rn on every fire.

contracts_mapped.name: p
contracts_mapped.description: It is the page URL. Microsoft documents p on pageLoad events, and as mandatory when page URL remarketing lists are used.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the absolute page URL in p.

contracts_mapped.name: r
contracts_mapped.description: It is the referrer URL. Microsoft documents r on pageLoad events.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the absolute referrer URL in r, or omit it.

contracts_mapped.name: uid
contracts_mapped.description: It is a customer-defined logged-in user ID that stays the same across browsers and devices.

contracts_mapped.name: vid
contracts_mapped.description: It is a customer-defined anonymous user ID.

contracts_mapped.name: msclkid
contracts_mapped.description: The current published UET table requires msclkid on every event. Send the documented N sentinel when no ad click exists or cookies are blocked; otherwise send the click GUID with its freshness/cookie suffix.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Forward the _uetmsclkid cookie as {guid}-0 or {guid}-1, or send N when there is no click.

contracts_mapped.name: kl
contracts_mapped.description: It is the page title. Microsoft documents kl on pageLoad events.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the page title in kl, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.name: tw
contracts_mapped.description: It is the SEO meta keywords for the current page. Microsoft documents tw on pageLoad events.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the page keywords in tw, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.name: pagetype
contracts_mapped.description: It is the page type on a custom event. Microsoft documents Cart, Category, Home, Other, Product, Purchase, and Search results.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send a documented pagetype such as Purchase or Product.

contracts_mapped.name: prodid
contracts_mapped.description: It is a comma-separated list of product IDs. Microsoft documents prodid as matching the ID or item_group_id in the MMC product feed.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send one or more product IDs, comma-separated, such as Prod123456.

contracts_mapped.name: search_term
contracts_mapped.description: It is the search query that led to the search results page. Microsoft documents search_term on custom events.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the search query in search_term, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.name: ecomm_category
contracts_mapped.description: It is the category ID on a category browse page. Microsoft documents ecomm_category on custom events.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the category ID in ecomm_category, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.name: transaction_id
contracts_mapped.description: It is a unique transaction ID. Microsoft documents transaction_id on custom events.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send a unique transaction ID, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.name: items
contracts_mapped.description: It is the product array on a custom event. Microsoft documents `items` as a JSON array of objects with `id`, `quantity`, and `price`.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `items` as a JSON array, such as `[{"id":"Prod123456","quantity":2,"price":25.1}]`.

contracts_mapped.name: ecomm_pagetype
contracts_mapped.description: It is the ecommerce page type. Microsoft documents home, searchresults, category, product, cart, purchase, and other.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send a documented ecomm_pagetype such as purchase or product.

contracts_mapped.name: ecomm_prodid
contracts_mapped.description: It is the product ID list for dynamic remarketing. Microsoft documents ecomm_prodid as matching the feed id or item_group_id.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send one or more product IDs in ecomm_prodid, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.name: ecomm_totalvalue
contracts_mapped.description: It is the cart or purchase total. Microsoft documents ecomm_totalvalue as a number.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send a number such as 50.20, with no currency symbol.

contracts_mapped.name: ecomm_query
contracts_mapped.description: It is the search query on a search-results page. Microsoft documents ecomm_query on custom events.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the search query in ecomm_query, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.name: ec
contracts_mapped.description: It is the custom event category. Microsoft documents ec on custom events, and forbids it on pageLoad.

contracts_mapped.name: ea
contracts_mapped.description: It is the custom event action. Microsoft documents ea on custom events, and forbids it on pageLoad.

contracts_mapped.name: el
contracts_mapped.description: It is the custom event label. Microsoft documents el on custom events, and forbids it on pageLoad.

contracts_mapped.name: ev
contracts_mapped.description: It is the custom event value. Microsoft documents ev as numeric, on custom events only.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send a number such as 42, not a currency string.

contracts_mapped.name: flight_destid
contracts_mapped.description: It is the flight destination ID. Microsoft documents flight_destid on the travel parameter table.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the destination ID in flight_destid, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.name: flight_originid
contracts_mapped.description: It is the flight origin ID. Microsoft documents flight_originid on the travel parameter table.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the origin ID in flight_originid, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.name: flight_pagetype
contracts_mapped.description: It is the flight page type. Microsoft documents flight_pagetype on the travel parameter table.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the flight page type in flight_pagetype, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.name: flight_startdate
contracts_mapped.description: It is the flight start date. Microsoft documents flight_startdate on the travel parameter table.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the start date in flight_startdate, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.name: flight_enddate
contracts_mapped.description: It is the flight end date. Microsoft documents flight_enddate on the travel parameter table.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the end date in flight_enddate, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.name: flight_totalvalue
contracts_mapped.description: It is the flight total value. Microsoft documents flight_totalvalue on the travel parameter table. Other UET value fields are numbers with no currency symbol.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send a number such as 249.00, with no currency symbol.

contracts_mapped.name: gv
contracts_mapped.description: It is variable revenue for conversion tracking.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send a number such as 20.55, with no currency symbol.

contracts_mapped.name: gc
contracts_mapped.description: It is the ISO 4217 currency of gv.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the three-letter code, such as USD.

contracts_mapped.name: campaign
contracts_mapped.description: It is the Partnerize campaign id, written as campaign:{CAMPAIGNID} on the conversion path.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Put the campaign id from Partnerize in the path as campaign:{id}.

contracts_mapped.name: clickref
contracts_mapped.description: The most recent captured click reference is required as a path key. Partnerize explicitly permits a blank clickref for clickless exclusive-code tracking.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Replay the stored clickref in the path as clickref:{value}.

contracts_mapped.name: currency
contracts_mapped.description: It is the ISO 4217 currency of the conversion. Partnerize documents it as required when the event has a monetary value.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Put a three-letter currency code in the path as currency:GBP.

contracts_mapped.name: conversionref
contracts_mapped.description: It is the brand's unique conversion reference. Partnerize documents it as required for validation, and says omit it when the brand cannot generate one.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Put a stable order id in the path as conversionref:{id}, or omit the pair and let Partnerize mint one.

contracts_mapped.name: tmethod
contracts_mapped.description: It is the tracking method. Partnerize documents `tmethod:2` on S2S conversion URLs.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `tmethod:2` on a server-to-server conversion.

contracts_mapped.name: tplatform
contracts_mapped.description: It is the tracking platform. Partnerize documents `tplatform:2` on S2S conversion URLs.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `tplatform:2` on a server-to-server conversion.

contracts_mapped.name: tracking_mode
contracts_mapped.description: It is the tracking mode. Partnerize S2S samples send `tracking_mode:api`.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `tracking_mode:api` on a server-to-server conversion.

contracts_mapped.name: country
contracts_mapped.description: It is the site country of the purchase. Partnerize documents ISO 3166 letter country codes.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send a two-letter ISO 3166-1 code, such as `GB`.

contracts_mapped.name: customertype
contracts_mapped.description: It is whether the buyer is a first-time or repeat customer. Partnerize documents `new` or `existing`, and says leave the pair blank when the value is unknown.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `customertype:new` or `customertype:existing`, or leave the value blank.

contracts_mapped.name: voucher
contracts_mapped.description: It is the voucher used at purchase. Partnerize documents that the item `value` must already reflect the discount.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the voucher code, or leave the pair blank.

contracts_mapped.name: fulfilment_date
contracts_mapped.description: It is the service delivery date. Partnerize documents `YYYY-MM-DD`.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `fulfilment_date` as `YYYY-MM-DD`, such as `2026-05-01`.

contracts_mapped.name: fulfilment_start_date
contracts_mapped.description: It is the start of the fulfilment period. Partnerize documents `YYYY-MM-DD`.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `fulfilment_start_date` as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

contracts_mapped.name: conversion_time
contracts_mapped.description: An optional UTC timestamp in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS form must sit outside the item block. Calendar and time ranges are checked. UTC provenance without an offset cannot be verified from the string.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `conversion_time` as `2021-10-01+18:33:03`.

contracts_mapped.name: device
contracts_mapped.description: It is the converting device. Partnerize documents `bot`, `desktop`, `mobile`, `tablet`, and `Other`.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `device:mobile` or another documented device value.

contracts_mapped.name: context
contracts_mapped.description: It is the converting context. Partnerize documents `web`, `m_web`, `m_app`, `in_app`, `cd_d`, `cd_p`, `other`, and `offline`.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `context:m_web` or another documented context value.

contracts_mapped.name: custref

contracts_mapped.name: metadata_outside_items

contracts_mapped.name: category

contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Put `category:{name}` inside each basket container.

contracts_mapped.name: sku
contracts_mapped.description: It is the item product code inside a basket container.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Put `sku:{code}` inside the basket container, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.name: value
contracts_mapped.description: It is the individual item value, excluding tax, delivery, and currency symbols. Partnerize multiplies it by `quantity`.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send a number such as `19.99`, with no currency symbol or comma.

contracts_mapped.name: quantity
contracts_mapped.description: It is the item quantity inside a basket container. Partnerize documents a positive number.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send a positive number, such as 1 or 0.5.

contracts_mapped.name: fulfilment_date

contracts_mapped.name: fulfilment_start_date
contracts_mapped.description: It is the start of the fulfilment period. Partnerize documents `YYYY-MM-DD`.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `fulfilment_start_date` as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

contracts_mapped.name: tid
contracts_mapped.description: It is the Pinterest conversion tag ID.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Copy the tag ID from Ads Manager into `tid`.

contracts_mapped.name: event
contracts_mapped.description: The base code omits it; event code sends one. Custom event names are allowed, so check that an unrecognized value is deliberate and not a misspelled standard event.

contracts_mapped.name: noscript
contracts_mapped.description: The image fallback in the base code sends `noscript=1`.

contracts_mapped.name: ed[value]
contracts_mapped.description: It is the purchase value on the noscript image. Pinterest documents `ed[value]` on checkout and add to cart tags.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send a number in `ed[value]`, without a currency symbol.

contracts_mapped.name: ed[currency]
contracts_mapped.description: It is the ISO 4217 currency of `ed[value]`. Pinterest documents `ed[currency]` on the image tag.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send a three-letter currency code in `ed[currency]`, such as `USD`.

contracts_mapped.name: ed[order_quantity]
contracts_mapped.description: It is the order quantity on the noscript image. Pinterest documents `ed[order_quantity]` next to `ed[value]`.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send an integer item count in `ed[order_quantity]`.

contracts_mapped.name: ed[event_id]
contracts_mapped.description: It is the event id on the noscript image. Pinterest documents `ed[event_id]` for deduplication against the JavaScript tag.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the same event id the JavaScript tag fired, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.name: pd[em]
contracts_mapped.description: It is the hashed email for Enhanced Match on the image tag. Pinterest documents SHA-256 hex after lowercase and trim. The JavaScript tag hashes in the browser; the img tag does not.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Lowercase and trim the address, hash it with SHA-256, and send the hex digest in `pd[em]`.

contracts_mapped.name: pd[external_id]
contracts_mapped.description: It is the hashed advertiser-side user id for Enhanced Match on the image tag. Pinterest documents SHA-256 hex.

contracts_mapped.name: event_name
contracts_mapped.description: It is the conversion event name. Pinterest documents a set of standard names and also allows a custom name of up to 100 characters.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send a documented name such as `checkout`, or a custom name mapped to a standard event in Ads Manager.

contracts_mapped.name: action_source
contracts_mapped.description: It is the platform the event was ingested from. Pinterest documents `web`, `app_android`, `app_ios`, and `offline`.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `web`, `app_android`, `app_ios`, or `offline`. Pinterest spells `web` in lower case, unlike Snap.

contracts_mapped.name: event_id
contracts_mapped.description: It identifies the event for deduplication against the Pinterest tag.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send a stable id per conversion, such as an order number.

contracts_mapped.name: event_time
contracts_mapped.description: Pinterest documents a Unix timestamp in seconds. A 13-digit value is milliseconds.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send seconds, not milliseconds: divide a JavaScript `Date.now()` by 1000 and floor it.

contracts_mapped.name: user_data
contracts_mapped.description: Pinterest requires a `user_data` object, and it must include at least one of `em`, `hashed_maids`, or an IP and user agent pair.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Add `user_data` with a hashed email, hashed MAIDs, or `client_ip_address` and `client_user_agent`.

contracts_mapped.name: user_data.em
contracts_mapped.description: Email must be lowercased and SHA-256 hashed before it is sent.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Lowercase the address, hash it with SHA-256, and send the hex digest.

contracts_mapped.name: user_data.em[]
contracts_mapped.description: Every email in the list must be lowercased and SHA-256 hashed.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Hash each address with SHA-256 and send the hex digest.

contracts_mapped.name: user_data.ph
contracts_mapped.description: Phone must be digits-only with country code, then SHA-256 hashed.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Strip symbols, keep the country code, hash with SHA-256, and send the hex digest.

contracts_mapped.name: user_data.external_id
contracts_mapped.description: External IDs must be SHA-256 hashed.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Hash the customer id with SHA-256 and send the hex digest.

contracts_mapped.name: user_data.client_ip_address
contracts_mapped.description: It is the visitor IP address, sent unhashed.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the browser's public IP, not a digest.

contracts_mapped.name: user_data.client_user_agent
contracts_mapped.description: It is the visitor user agent, sent unhashed.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the browser's user agent string, not a digest.

contracts_mapped.name: user_data.hashed_maids
contracts_mapped.description: Hashed GAID or IDFA. Pinterest documents SHA-256.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Hash the MAID with SHA-256 and send the hex digest.

contracts_mapped.name: user_data.hashed_maids[]
contracts_mapped.description: Every MAID in the list must be SHA-256 hashed.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Hash each MAID with SHA-256 and send the hex digest.

contracts_mapped.name: custom_data.currency
contracts_mapped.description: It is an ISO 4217 currency code.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Use the three-letter code, such as `USD`.

contracts_mapped.name: custom_data.value
contracts_mapped.description: It is the total monetary value of purchased items. Pinterest documents a string parsed as a double, with no negatives, and currency whenever it is sent.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the pre-tax, pre-shipping total in `custom_data.value` as a number, such as `66.95`.

contracts_mapped.name: custom_data.content_ids
contracts_mapped.description: It is a product ID related to the event. Pinterest documents an array of IDs that also appear on `custom_data.contents`.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send catalog IDs in `custom_data.content_ids`, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.name: custom_data.content_ids[]
contracts_mapped.description: Every listed ID is a product ID related to the event.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send catalog IDs in `custom_data.content_ids`, or drop empty entries.

contracts_mapped.name: custom_data.content_name
contracts_mapped.description: It is the name of the page or product associated with the event.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the page or product name in `custom_data.content_name`, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.name: custom_data.content_category
contracts_mapped.description: It is the type of merchandise. Pinterest documents `content_category` on the product event table.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the merchandise type in `custom_data.content_category`, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.name: custom_data.content_brand
contracts_mapped.description: It is the brand of merchandise. Pinterest documents `content_brand` on the product event table.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the brand in `custom_data.content_brand`, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.name: custom_data.num_items
contracts_mapped.description: It is the total number of products involved, for example items purchased in a checkout.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send a whole number in `custom_data.num_items`, such as `2`.

contracts_mapped.name: custom_data.order_id
contracts_mapped.description: It identifies the order in a purchase-related event.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the order id in `custom_data.order_id`, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.name: custom_data.search_string
contracts_mapped.description: It is the string entered in a search event.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the query in `custom_data.search_string`, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.name: custom_data.opt_out_type
contracts_mapped.description: It is the privacy opt-out type. Pinterest documents `ldp` as the only accepted value for limited data processing.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set `custom_data.opt_out_type` to `ldp`, or drop the pair.

contracts_mapped.name: custom_data.contents[].id
contracts_mapped.description: It is the product ID of an individual merchandise item.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set `custom_data.contents[].id` to the catalog item ID, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.name: custom_data.contents[].item_name
contracts_mapped.description: It is the product name of an individual merchandise item.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set `custom_data.contents[].item_name` to the product name, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.name: custom_data.contents[].item_category
contracts_mapped.description: It is the product category of an individual merchandise item.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set `custom_data.contents[].item_category` to the category, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.name: custom_data.contents[].item_brand
contracts_mapped.description: It is the brand of an individual merchandise item.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set `custom_data.contents[].item_brand` to the brand, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.name: custom_data.contents[].item_price
contracts_mapped.description: It is the price of one merchandise item (single quantity). Pinterest documents it as a string parsed as a number.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `custom_data.contents[].item_price` as a number, such as `19.99`. Put the order total in `custom_data.value`.

contracts_mapped.name: custom_data.contents[].quantity
contracts_mapped.description: It is the quantity of that merchandise item selected by the user.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send a whole number in `custom_data.contents[].quantity`, such as `2`.

cross_field_inventory.message: `user_data` carries none of the identifiers Pinterest requires. Send `em`, `hashed_maids`, or `client_ip_address` with `client_user_agent`.

cross_field_inventory.message: A field carries what looks like a raw email address. Pinterest requires `user_data.em` to be a SHA-256 hex digest.

cross_field_inventory.message: This field looks like a SHA-256 digest, but Pinterest documents `client_ip_address` and `client_user_agent` as unhashed.
cross_field_inventory.fix_hint: Send the raw IP address or user agent. Hashing it makes the event unmatchable.

contracts_mapped.name: custom_data.content_brand

rules.message: A `checkout` event is missing `custom_data.value` or `custom_data.currency`. Pinterest documents both as recommended for checkout.
rules.fix_hint: Send the checkout total and a three-letter currency code.

rules.message: The event carries `custom_data.value` with no `custom_data.currency`. Pinterest documents currency as required whenever value is sent.
rules.fix_hint: Add `custom_data.currency` as a three-letter code alongside the value.

rules.message: `user_data` carries none of the identifiers Pinterest requires. Send `em`, `hashed_maids`, or `client_ip_address` with `client_user_agent`.
rules.fix_hint: Add a hashed email, hashed MAIDs, or the IP and user agent pair.

rules.message: A field carries what looks like a raw email address. Pinterest requires `user_data.em` to be a SHA-256 hex digest.
rules.fix_hint: Lowercase the address, hash it with SHA-256, and send the hex digest.

rules.message: This field looks like a SHA-256 digest, but Pinterest documents `client_ip_address` and `client_user_agent` as unhashed.
rules.fix_hint: Send the raw IP address or user agent. Hashing it makes the event unmatchable.

contracts_mapped.name: pixel_id
contracts_mapped.description: It is the Reddit Pixel ID, and it travels in the v3 path.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Put the Pixel ID from Events Manager in the path as `/api/v3/pixels/{pixel_id}/conversion_events`.

contracts_mapped.name: event_at
contracts_mapped.description: Reddit CAPI v3 documents `event_at` as Unix time in milliseconds. A 10-digit value is seconds and lands in 1970.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send milliseconds: a JavaScript `Date.now()` is already in the right unit.

contracts_mapped.name: action_source
contracts_mapped.description: v3 makes `action_source` required. Reddit documents `WEBSITE`, `APP`, `PHYSICAL_STORE`, and `OTHER`.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `WEBSITE`, `APP`, `PHYSICAL_STORE`, or `OTHER`.

contracts_mapped.name: type.tracking_type
contracts_mapped.description: v3 spells standard events in UPPER_SNAKE_CASE. Custom events use `CUSTOM` plus `custom_event_name`.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `PURCHASE` or another documented type. For a custom event, send `CUSTOM` and `type.custom_event_name`.

contracts_mapped.name: click_id
contracts_mapped.description: It is the Reddit click id. Reddit documents it as a match key and reads it from `event_source_url` when the field itself is omitted.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the `rdt_cid` click id in `click_id`, or put it on `event_source_url`.

contracts_mapped.name: event_source_url
contracts_mapped.description: Reddit documents `event_source_url` as recommended on `WEBSITE` events so the domain can be extracted.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the absolute page URL in `event_source_url`.

contracts_mapped.name: type.custom_event_name
contracts_mapped.description: It is the custom event name. Reddit documents it as required when `tracking_type` is `CUSTOM`, any UTF-8 character up to 64 characters including spaces.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set `type.custom_event_name` to a name that is not a standard tracking type, at most 64 characters.

contracts_mapped.name: metadata.currency
contracts_mapped.description: It is an ISO 4217 currency code.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Use the three-letter code, such as `USD`.

contracts_mapped.name: metadata.value
contracts_mapped.description: It is the conversion value. Reddit documents `value` as strongly recommended on revenue events.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set `metadata.value` to the order total on `PURCHASE`.

contracts_mapped.name: metadata.conversion_id
contracts_mapped.description: It is the id Reddit uses to deduplicate Pixel and CAPI events. Reddit strongly recommends it when both fire.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the same `conversion_id` the Pixel sent.

contracts_mapped.name: metadata.item_count
contracts_mapped.description: It is the number of items in the conversion. Reddit documents `item_count` as strongly recommended on revenue events, and says product `quantity` is not a replacement.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set `metadata.item_count` to the order item count, such as `2`.

contracts_mapped.name: metadata.products[].id
contracts_mapped.description: It is the product id on a metadata products row. Reddit documents `id` on each product object.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set `metadata.products[].id` to the SKU or catalog id, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.name: metadata.products[].name
contracts_mapped.description: It is the product name on a metadata products row. Reddit documents `name` on each product object.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set `metadata.products[].name` to the product name, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.name: metadata.products[].category
contracts_mapped.description: It is the product category on a metadata products row. Reddit documents `category` on each product object.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set `metadata.products[].category` to the category, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.name: metadata.products[].quantity
contracts_mapped.description: It is the quantity of that product. Reddit documents `quantity` on each product object. It is not a replacement for `metadata.item_count`.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `metadata.products[].quantity` as a whole number, such as `2`.

contracts_mapped.name: metadata.products[].item_price
contracts_mapped.description: It is the unit price of that product. Reddit documents `item_price` on each product object. It is not a replacement for `metadata.value`.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `metadata.products[].item_price` as a number, such as `9.99`. Put the order total in `metadata.value`.

contracts_mapped.name: user.email
contracts_mapped.description: It is the visitor email. Reddit accepts it unhashed or as SHA-256 hex.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send a canonical email, or the SHA-256 hex digest.

contracts_mapped.name: user.phone_number
contracts_mapped.description: It is the visitor phone number. Reddit accepts it unhashed or as SHA-256 hex.

contracts_mapped.name: user.uuid
contracts_mapped.description: It is the Reddit UUID match key. Reddit documents it for session-based deduplication against the Pixel.

contracts_mapped.name: user.external_id
contracts_mapped.description: It is an advertiser-assigned identifier. Reddit documents it as a match key.

contracts_mapped.name: user.idfa
contracts_mapped.description: It is the iOS advertising id. Reddit documents it as a match key.

contracts_mapped.name: user.aaid
contracts_mapped.description: It is the Android advertising id. Reddit documents it as a match key.

contracts_mapped.name: user.ip_address
contracts_mapped.description: It is the visitor IP address. Reddit accepts it unhashed.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the browser's public IP, not a digest.

contracts_mapped.name: user.user_agent
contracts_mapped.description: It is the visitor user agent. Reddit accepts it unhashed.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the browser's user agent string, not a digest.

contracts_mapped.name: user.screen_dimensions.width
contracts_mapped.description: It is the display width. Reddit documents `user.screen_dimensions.width` as a match-key field.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `user.screen_dimensions.width` as an integer pixel count.

contracts_mapped.name: user.screen_dimensions.height
contracts_mapped.description: It is the display height. Reddit documents `user.screen_dimensions.height` as a match-key field.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `user.screen_dimensions.height` as an integer pixel count.

contracts_mapped.name: user.data_processing_options.modes[]
contracts_mapped.description: It is the Limited Data Use mode. Reddit documents `modes` as the fixed value `LDU`.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `user.data_processing_options.modes` as `["LDU"]`.

contracts_mapped.name: user.data_processing_options.country
contracts_mapped.description: It is the country for Limited Data Use. Reddit documents country as required when LDU is set.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `user.data_processing_options.country` when `modes` includes `LDU`.

contracts_mapped.name: user.data_processing_options.region
contracts_mapped.description: It is the region for Limited Data Use. Reddit documents region as optional when LDU is set.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `user.data_processing_options.region`, or omit it.

contracts_mapped.name: a
contracts_mapped.description: It is the Singular SDK Key, not the Reporting API Key, and every EVENT request requires it.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the SDK Key as `a`.

contracts_mapped.name: p
contracts_mapped.description: It is the platform, case-sensitive. Singular documents the values Android, iOS, Web, PC, Xbox, Playstation, Nintendo, MetaQuest, and CTV.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set `p` to the documented platform spelling, such as `iOS`.

contracts_mapped.name: i
contracts_mapped.description: It is the app identifier, case-sensitive, and every EVENT request requires it.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the app ID as `i`.

contracts_mapped.name: n
contracts_mapped.description: The event name has at most 32 UTF-8 bytes, including non-ASCII names.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Use an event name of at most 32 UTF-8 bytes.

contracts_mapped.name: ip
contracts_mapped.description: It is the public device IP. Singular requires `ip` or `use_ip`, and they are mutually exclusive.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the device IPv4 as `ip`, or send `use_ip` instead.

contracts_mapped.name: use_ip
contracts_mapped.description: It tells Singular to use the request IP. Mutually exclusive with `ip`.

contracts_mapped.name: sdid
contracts_mapped.description: It is the Singular device ID, a UUIDv4. V2 requires it. New accounts as of 15 July 2026 must use V2.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: On `/api/v2/evt`, send `sdid` as a UUIDv4.

contracts_mapped.name: cur
contracts_mapped.description: It is an ISO 4217 currency code, uppercase, used with `amt` on revenue events.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `cur` as `USD` together with `amt`.

contracts_mapped.name: amt
contracts_mapped.description: It is the revenue amount. Singular documents a number used with `cur`. Sending it makes the call a revenue event.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `amt` as a number such as `2.51`, together with `cur`.

contracts_mapped.name: idfa
contracts_mapped.description: It is the iOS Identifier for Advertisers. Singular documents a UUIDv4 on EVENT V1. Omit it when unavailable. Never send an empty string.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `idfa` as a UUID, or omit the pair.

contracts_mapped.name: idfv
contracts_mapped.description: It is the iOS Identifier for Vendor. Singular documents a UUIDv4, required on iOS V1 regardless of ATT.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `idfv` as a UUID on iOS V1.

contracts_mapped.name: aifa
contracts_mapped.description: It is the Google advertising ID. Singular documents a UUIDv4 on Google Play V1.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `aifa` as a UUID, or omit the pair off Google Play.

contracts_mapped.name: asid
contracts_mapped.description: It is the Android App Set ID. Singular documents a UUIDv4 on Google Play V1.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `asid` as a UUID on Google Play V1.

contracts_mapped.name: amid
contracts_mapped.description: It is the Amazon advertising ID. Singular documents a UUIDv4 for Fire devices.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `amid` as a UUID on Amazon devices, or omit the pair.

contracts_mapped.name: oaid
contracts_mapped.description: It is the Open Advertising Identifier on Chinese OEM Android. Singular documents a UUID, but the published example is not a valid UUID, so only emptiness is checked.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `oaid` when the device has no Google Play, or omit the pair.

contracts_mapped.name: andi
contracts_mapped.description: It is the Android ID. Singular documents it only when no other identifier is available and the app is not on Google Play.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `andi` only off Google Play when AIFA and ASID are unavailable.

contracts_mapped.name: ve
contracts_mapped.description: It is the OS version at event time. Singular documents it on EVENT requests.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `ve` as the OS version, such as `9.2`.

contracts_mapped.name: ua
contracts_mapped.description: It is the device user agent. Singular documents it URL-encoded and unhashed.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the raw user agent as `ua`.

contracts_mapped.name: lc
contracts_mapped.description: It is the IETF locale as `ll_CC`. Singular documents the plain form, with no Unicode extensions.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `lc` as `en_US`.

contracts_mapped.name: country
contracts_mapped.description: It is an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Singular documents it when `use_ip=true` or no IP is available.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send a two-letter code such as `US`.

contracts_mapped.name: c
contracts_mapped.description: It is the network connection type. Singular documents `wifi` or `carrier`.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `c` as `wifi` or `carrier`.

contracts_mapped.name: att_authorization_status
contracts_mapped.description: It is the iOS ATT status. Singular documents 0 undetermined, 1 restricted, 2 denied, 3 authorized.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `0`, `1`, `2`, or `3`. Pass `0` when ATT is not implemented.

contracts_mapped.name: utime
contracts_mapped.description: It is the event time as a 10-digit Unix timestamp.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `utime` as 10-digit Unix seconds, such as `1483228800`.

contracts_mapped.name: umilisec
contracts_mapped.description: It is the event time as a 13-digit Unix timestamp in milliseconds.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `umilisec` as 13-digit Unix milliseconds, such as `1483228800000`.

contracts_mapped.name: is_revenue_event
contracts_mapped.description: It marks a revenue event. Singular still treats the event as revenue when `amt` is present.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `true` or `false`. Omit `amt` if the event is not revenue.

contracts_mapped.name: ma
contracts_mapped.description: It is the device make. Singular documents it together with `mo`.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `ma` and `mo` together, such as `Apple` and `iPhone 4S`.

contracts_mapped.name: mo
contracts_mapped.description: It is the device model. Singular documents it together with `ma`.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `ma` and `mo` together.

contracts_mapped.name: e
contracts_mapped.description: It is a JSON object of custom event attributes, URL-encoded. Singular documents a JSON object.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send a JSON object such as `{"sng_attr_content_id":5581}`, URL-encoded.

contracts_mapped.name: access_token
contracts_mapped.description: The events endpoint authenticates with an access token on the request.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the Conversions API access token, and keep it out of anything client-side.

contracts_mapped.name: data
contracts_mapped.description: The vendor documents the JSON shape or value type of this field.

contracts_mapped.name: data[]
contracts_mapped.description: The vendor documents the JSON shape or value type of this field.

contracts_mapped.name: event_name
contracts_mapped.description: Snap documents a fixed set of event types, spelled in upper case with underscores.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Use one of the documented event types, such as `PAGE_VIEW` or `PURCHASE`.

contracts_mapped.name: event_time
contracts_mapped.description: It is the epoch timestamp of the conversion, and Snap only accepts events from the last 7 days.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the epoch timestamp of the conversion, not of the moment you forwarded it.

contracts_mapped.name: action_source
contracts_mapped.description: It says where the event took place, and Snap accepts three values.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Use `WEB`, `OFFLINE`, or `MOBILE_APP`. Snap spells these in upper case, unlike Meta.

contracts_mapped.name: event_source_url
contracts_mapped.description: It is the URL of the page the event happened on, and Snap requires it for web events.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the full page URL, including the scheme.

contracts_mapped.name: event_id
contracts_mapped.description: It is an advertiser-chosen identifier for deduplication against the Pixel. Snap documents it as recommended for unique events. An empty pair cannot collapse a web and CAPI pair.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the same `event_id` the Pixel used as `client_dedup_id`, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.name: user_data
contracts_mapped.description: Snap matches the conversion on customer information, and the event needs at least one identifier.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Add a `user_data` object carrying a hashed email, hashed phone, mobile ad id, or IP and user agent pair.

contracts_mapped.name: user_data.em
contracts_mapped.description: Email must be normalized and SHA-256 hashed before it is sent.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Trim and lowercase the address, hash it with SHA-256, and send the hex digest.

contracts_mapped.name: user_data.em[]
contracts_mapped.description: Every email in the list must be normalized and SHA-256 hashed.

contracts_mapped.name: user_data.ph
contracts_mapped.description: Phone must be normalized and SHA-256 hashed before it is sent.

contracts_mapped.name: user_data.ph[]
contracts_mapped.description: Every phone number in the list must be normalized and SHA-256 hashed.

contracts_mapped.name: user_data.fn
contracts_mapped.description: First name must be SHA-256 hashed.

contracts_mapped.name: user_data.ln
contracts_mapped.description: Last name must be SHA-256 hashed.

contracts_mapped.name: user_data.ge
contracts_mapped.description: Gender must be SHA-256 hashed.

contracts_mapped.name: user_data.ct
contracts_mapped.description: City must be SHA-256 hashed.

contracts_mapped.name: user_data.st
contracts_mapped.description: State must be SHA-256 hashed.

contracts_mapped.name: user_data.zp
contracts_mapped.description: Postal code must be SHA-256 hashed.

contracts_mapped.name: user_data.country
contracts_mapped.description: Country must be SHA-256 hashed.

contracts_mapped.name: user_data.client_ip_address
contracts_mapped.description: It is sent unhashed, and it must be the address of the browser rather than of your server.

contracts_mapped.name: user_data.client_user_agent
contracts_mapped.description: It is sent unhashed, and it must be the browser's user agent rather than your HTTP client's.

contracts_mapped.name: user_data.sc_click_id
contracts_mapped.description: It is the Snap click ID from the landing-page `ScCid` query. Snap documents it as unhashed.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Copy `ScCid` from the landing URL into `user_data.sc_click_id`, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.name: user_data.sc_cookie1
contracts_mapped.description: It is the first-party `_scid` cookie. Snap documents it as unhashed and recommended for match rate.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Read `_scid` under your domain into `user_data.sc_cookie1`, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.name: user_data.madid
contracts_mapped.description: It is the mobile advertiser ID. Snap documents it as lowercase and unhashed.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the IDFA or GAID in lowercase, unhashed, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.name: user_data.idfv
contracts_mapped.description: It is the plain-text IDFV. Snap documents it as unhashed and recommended for app events.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the IDFV unhashed, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.name: custom_data.value
contracts_mapped.description: It is the monetary value of the event. Snap documents a float, required for PURCHASE, with no currency symbol.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the purchase total in `custom_data.value` as a number, such as `10`.

contracts_mapped.name: custom_data.currency
contracts_mapped.description: It is the currency of `custom_data.value`. Snap documents a subset of ISO 4217, not every three-letter code.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send a documented code such as `USD`.

contracts_mapped.name: custom_data.order_id
contracts_mapped.description: It is the order identifier. Snap documents it on the Dynamic Ads custom_data table.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the order id in `custom_data.order_id`, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.name: custom_data.content_type
contracts_mapped.description: It says what `content_ids` or `contents` represent. Snap documents `product` for a single item or `product_group` for a variant group.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set `custom_data.content_type` to `product` or `product_group`.

contracts_mapped.name: custom_data.content_ids
contracts_mapped.description: It is a product or category identifier. Snap documents a single id, an array, or a comma-separated list.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send a catalog id in `custom_data.content_ids`, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.name: custom_data.content_ids[]
contracts_mapped.description: Every id in the list is a product or category identifier.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send catalog ids in `custom_data.content_ids`, or drop empty entries.

contracts_mapped.name: custom_data.num_items
contracts_mapped.description: It is the total number of items. Snap documents it as a string.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send a whole number in `custom_data.num_items`, such as `2`.

contracts_mapped.name: custom_data.contents[].id
contracts_mapped.description: It is the item id on a contents row. Snap documents `id` on each contents object.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Set `custom_data.contents[].id` to the catalog item ID, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.name: custom_data.contents[].quantity
contracts_mapped.description: It is the item count on a contents row. Snap's published example sends it as a number string.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `custom_data.contents[].quantity` as a number, such as `1`.

contracts_mapped.name: custom_data.contents[].item_price
contracts_mapped.description: It is the unit price of one item. Snap's published example sends `item_price` as a number string.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `custom_data.contents[].item_price` as a number, such as `5`. Put the order total in `custom_data.value`.

contracts_mapped.name: custom_data.content_name
contracts_mapped.description: It is the name of the page or product associated with the event. Snap documents it on the Dynamic Ads custom_data table.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the page or product name in `custom_data.content_name`, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.name: custom_data.content_category
contracts_mapped.description: It is an item or category. Snap documents a single category or an array.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send a category in `custom_data.content_category`, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.name: custom_data.content_category[]
contracts_mapped.description: Every entry in the list is an item or category.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send categories in `custom_data.content_category`, or drop empty entries.

contracts_mapped.name: custom_data.search_string
contracts_mapped.description: It is the text that was searched for. Snap documents it on the Dynamic Ads custom_data table.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send the query in `custom_data.search_string`, or drop the empty pair.

contracts_mapped.name: custom_data.predicted_ltv
contracts_mapped.description: It is the predicted lifetime value of the conversion. Snap documents a float.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send `custom_data.predicted_ltv` as a number, such as `120.5`.

contracts_mapped.name: custom_data.checkin_date
contracts_mapped.description: It is the hotel check-in date in the hotel's time zone. Snap documents YYYYMMDD, YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmTZD, and YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssTZD.
contracts_mapped.fix_hint: Send a documented check-in date such as `20261015` or `2026-10-15`.

contracts_mapped.name: custom_data.origin_airport
